global.faq.heading: Tambayoyin da marasa lafiya ke yi
global.faq.items.0.question: Nawa Medsafar take karɓa daga gare ni?
global.faq.items.0.answer: Babu komai don shirin jinya da ƙiyasin kuɗi. Kuna biyan asibiti kuɗin jinya da kuɗaɗen tafiya da masauki da aka saba. Duk abin da Medsafar za ta karɓa ana rubuta shi kafin ku amince.
global.faq.items.1.question: Me ya sa babu farashi a wannan shafi?
global.faq.items.1.answer: Domin ainihin adadi ya dogara da rahotanninku, asibiti da tsawon zamanku. Inda asibiti ya ba mu farashin fakitinsa, suna a shafin asibitin a matsayin jagora. Ko ta yaya, muna aiko muku da ƙiyasin kuɗi a rubuce wanda aka shirya don al'amarinku.
global.faq.items.2.question: Shin Medsafar asibiti ce?
global.faq.items.2.answer: A'a. Medsafar mai sauƙaƙa tafiye-tafiyen jinya ce. Asibitoci da likitoci masu zaman kansu a Indiya ne ke ba da jinya. Mu muna shirya duk abin da ke kewaye da ita.
global.faq.items.3.question: Waɗanne rahotanni zan aika?
global.faq.items.3.answer: Duk abin da kuke da shi: wasiƙar likita, hotunan na'ura, sakamakon gwajin jini ko takardar sallama daga asibiti. Hotuna masu kyau da aka ɗauka da waya sun isa.
global.faq.items.4.question: Yaushe wani zai amsa?
global.faq.items.4.answer: Mai kula da al'amura zai karɓi tambayarku ya tuntuɓe ku ta WhatsApp ko ta kira. Ra'ayin likita yana ɗaukar lokaci fiye da haka, domin dole ƙwararren likita ya karanta rahotannin.
global.faq.items.5.question: Kwana nawa zan yi a Indiya?
global.faq.items.5.answer: Ya danganta da abin da kuke buƙata. Duba lafiya ko ƙaramar jinya na iya ɗaukar 'yan kwanaki kawai. Babbar tiyata, kamar maye gurbin gwiwa ko kwatangwalo, yawanci tana nufin mako biyu zuwa uku, don ku murmure kafin jirgin komawa gida. Shirin jinyarku zai gaya muku abin da za ku yi tsammani.
global.faq.items.6.question: Shin ɗan uwa zai iya tafiya tare da ni?
global.faq.items.6.answer: I, kuma yana da amfani a sami wani tare da ku. Bizar jinya ta Indiya tana ba da izinin masu rakiya, don haka muna ƙara su a wasiƙar gayyatar biza kuma muna shirya musu ɗaki kusa da asibiti.
global.faq.items.7.question: Yaya ake biyan kuɗin jinya?
global.faq.items.7.answer: Kuna biyan asibiti, bisa rubutaccen ƙiyasin da ya ba ku. Wasu asibitoci suna karɓar ƙaramin ajiya don tabbatar da kwantar da ku, sauran kuma ana biya bayan kun iso. Muna duba kowane adadi tare da ku tun da wuri.
global.faq.items.8.question: Shin Medsafar tana taimakawa bayan na koma gida?
global.faq.items.8.answer: I. Muna shirya kiran bibiya da likitanku, muna raba rahotanninku da likitanku na gida idan kuna so, kuma muna ci gaba da tuntuɓar ku yayin da kuke murmurewa.
global.faq.items.9.question: Me ke faruwa da rahotannin lafiyata?
global.faq.items.9.answer: Suna zuwa ga likitoci da asibitocin da ke duba al'amarinku, ba wani wuri dabam ba. Kuna duba akwati don ba da izini kafin mu raba komai.

catalog.treatments.detail.cost.factors.4: Kwanaki a asibiti, duk wani lokaci a sashen kulawa ta musamman da makonnin da kuke murmurewa a Indiya.

about.who.body.0: Medsafar tana taimaka wa mutanen da ke zaune a wajen Indiya su samu kulawar lafiya mai inganci a Indiya a farashi mai adalci. Muna haɗa kowane mara lafiya da gogaggun likitoci, likitocin tiyata da asibitoci masu fannoni da yawa, kuma muna kula da duk abin da ke kewaye da jinyar don mara lafiya da iyalinsa su mai da hankali kan samun sauƙi.
about.who.body.1: Medsafar India reshe ne na Travgrub Private Limited, kamfanin tafiye-tafiye da ke Mumbai. Shi ya sa muke kula da ɓangaren tafiya da kanmu: wasiƙar gayyatar biza, jiragen sama, ɗaukar ku a filin jirgi da wurin zama.

about.founder.name: Vicky Prabhu
about.founder.role: Wanda ya kafa kuma Babban Darakta, Medsafar India
about.founder.picture.alt: Vicky Prabhu, wanda ya kafa kuma Babban Daraktan Medsafar
about.founder.quote.text: Medsafar tana nan ne don mayar da burina na tsawon rayuwa na yi wa bil'adama hidima zuwa aiki: taimaka wa marasa lafiya su samu kulawar da suke buƙata, da kawo bege ga iyalai a lokutansu mafi wahala.
about.founder.story.heading: Dalilin da ya sa na fara Medsafar
about.founder.story.body.0: Kullum ina son yin wani abu mai ma'ana ga mutane. Shekarun da na yi tare da Rotary sun nuna mini cewa ko ƙaramin aikin alheri na iya kawo babban canji a rayuwar wani.
about.founder.story.body.1: Gudanar da Travgrub ya koya mini cewa tafiya ta shafi mutane ne, ba tikiti ba. Taimakon biza, ɗaukar ku a filin jirgi, wurin zama, wanda za ku kira idan kuna buƙatar taimako: ƙananan abubuwa ne da ke kawo kwanciyar hankali na gaske a ƙasar da ba ku sani ba.
about.founder.story.body.2: Idan wani ya kamu da rashin lafiya mai tsanani, duk iyalin suna ɗaukar tsoron. Medsafar tana amfani da gogewata ta tafiye-tafiye ta hanya mafi ma'ana: tsayawa tare da marasa lafiya da iyalansu, don kada su taɓa jin su kaɗai ne.
about.founder.contact.body: Medsafar ƙarama ce da gangan. Vicky da kansa yake kula da kowane mara lafiya, daga saƙon farko har zuwa bibiya a gida.
about.founder.contact.label: Aika wa Vicky saƙo a WhatsApp
about.mission.heading: Abin da muke nan dominsa
about.mission.items.0.title: Manufarmu
about.mission.items.0.body: Taimaka wa marasa lafiya su samu kulawar da ta dace a Indiya, da kawo bege ga iyalansu, mara lafiya ɗaya bayan ɗaya.
about.mission.items.1.title: Hangen nesanmu
about.mission.items.1.body: Mu zama suna amintacce ga marasa lafiya daga Afirka, Gabas ta Tsakiya, yankin CIS da Kudancin Asiya, ba tare da rasa kulawa ta kai da kai ba.
about.mission.items.2.title: Mayar da alheri
about.mission.items.2.body: Yayin da Medsafar ke girma, wani ƙayyadadden kaso na kuɗin shigarta zai taimaka wa marasa lafiya da ba za su iya biyan jinyar da suke buƙata ba, tare da bayyanannun ƙa'idoji kan wanda ya cancanta.
about.values.heading: Alƙawarinmu ga kowane iyali
about.values.intro: Tura wanda kuke ƙauna zuwa ƙasar waje don jinya abin tsoro ne. Ga abin da za ku iya dogara da shi.
about.values.items.0.title: Ku ba wani al'amari kawai ba ne
about.values.items.0.body: Ku iyali ne da ke amincewa da mu a ɗaya daga cikin lokuta mafi wahala a rayuwarku. Muna ɗaukar wannan amana da muhimmanci.
about.values.items.1.title: Gaskiya, a kodayaushe
about.values.items.1.body: Babu wanda zai iya yin alƙawarin sakamakon jinya. Muna alƙawarin gaskiya, kulawa da bayyanannun bayanai, don ku yanke shawara da tabbaci.
about.values.items.2.title: Ba za ku taɓa kasancewa ku kaɗai ba
about.values.items.2.body: Asibitoci, ƙwararrun likitoci, tafiya da wurin zama, an shirya muku, tare da wanda za ku koma gare shi a kowane mataki.
about.does.heading: Abin da Medsafar ke yi
about.does.items.0: Tana aika rahotanninku ga gogaggen likita a asibitin abokin hulɗa
about.does.items.1: Tana dawo muku da shirin jinya da aka yi don al'amarinku, tare da ƙiyasin kuɗi a rubuce daga asibiti
about.does.items.2: Tana ba ku mai tsara al'amura a Indiya, wanda za a iya samu a kowane lokaci
about.does.items.3: Tana shirya wasiƙar gayyatar biza, jiragen sama, ɗaukar ku a filin jirgi da wurin zama
about.does.items.4: Tana hulɗa da kamfanin inshorarku idan inshora ta ɗauki nauyin jinyarku
about.does.items.5: Tana kiyaye sirrin bayananku da rahotanninku
about.does.items.6: Tana bayyana kowane kuɗi kafin ku amince
about.doesNot.heading: Abin da Medsafar ba ta yi
about.doesNot.items.0: Ba da jinya ko shawarar likita
about.doesNot.items.1: Yanke shawara kan jinyarku. Wannan tsakaninku da likita ne
about.doesNot.items.2: Ƙayyade kuɗin jinya. Ƙiyasin daga asibitin da ke jinyar yake zuwa
about.selection.heading: Yadda ake zaɓar likitoci da asibitoci
about.selection.body: Muna aiki ne kawai da likitoci da likitocin tiyata masu gogewar fiye da shekaru 15, a asibitoci masu fannoni da yawa a Indiya. Al'amarinku yana zuwa ga ƙwararren likita a fannin cutarku, wanda yake karanta rahotanninku kafin a shirya komai.

contact.meta.title: Tuntuɓi Medsafar India.
contact.meta.description: Fara shirin jinya kyauta, ko ku same Medsafar ta WhatsApp, ta waya ko ta imel.
contact.heading: Ku gaya mana abin da kuke buƙata.
contact.intro: Ku aiko mana da bayananku da rahotanninku. Mai kula da al'amura yana amsawa ta WhatsApp ko ta kira, kuma ƙwararren likita a Indiya yana duba al'amarinku kyauta.
contact.details.heading: Ku yi magana da mu kai tsaye
contact.details.intro: Kowane saƙo yana isa ga ainihin mai kula da al'amura, ba cibiyar kira ba.
contact.details.items.0.label: WhatsApp
contact.details.items.1.label: Waya
contact.details.items.1.hint: Ku kira mu a kowane lokaci
contact.details.items.2.label: Imel
contact.details.items.3.label: Ofis
contact.details.items.3.value: Office No. 222, 2nd Floor, NEO Corporate Plaza, Ramchandra Lane, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400064, India
contact.form.heading: Samu shirin jinyarku kyauta
contact.form.intro: Yana ɗaukar minti ɗaya. Babu kuɗi, babu wajibci.
contact.steps.heading: Abin da zai biyo baya
contact.steps.items.0.title: Za mu kira ku
contact.steps.items.0.body: Mai kula da al'amura zai tuntuɓe ku, ya saurari abin da kuke buƙata kuma ya nemi duk rahotannin da kuke da su.
contact.steps.items.1.title: Ƙwararren likita yana duba al'amarinku
contact.steps.items.1.body: Gogaggen likita a asibitin abokin hulɗa yana karanta rahotanninku ya ba da shawarar shiri, tare da ƙiyasin kuɗi a rubuce.
contact.steps.items.2.title: Muna shirya tafiyar
contact.steps.items.2.body: Da zarar kun yanke shawara, muna shirya wasiƙar gayyatar biza, jiragen sama, ɗaukar ku a filin jirgi, masauki da mai tsara al'amura a Indiya.
contact.why.heading: Dalilin da ya sa marasa lafiya ke zaɓar Medsafar
contact.why.items.0.title: Manyan likitoci kaɗai
contact.why.items.0.body: Al'amarinku yana zuwa ga ƙwararren likita mai gogewar fiye da shekaru 15, a asibiti mai fannoni da yawa.
contact.why.items.1.title: Bayyanannun kuɗaɗe, tun da wuri
contact.why.items.1.body: Ƙiyasin yana zuwa a rubuce daga asibiti. Kuna ganin kowane kuɗi kafin ku amince da komai.
contact.why.items.2.title: Ƙungiya ɗaya, daga farko har ƙarshe
contact.why.items.2.body: Daga saƙon farko har zuwa bibiya a gida, mai kula da al'amura ɗaya ne ke kula da ku da iyalinku.
contact.faq.heading: Kafin ku tuntuɓe mu
contact.faq.items.0.question: Shin zan biya wani abu don samun shirin jinya?
contact.faq.items.0.answer: A'a. Ra'ayin likita, shirin jinya da ƙiyasin kuɗi kyauta ne, kuma ba ku da wajibcin ci gaba.
contact.faq.items.1.question: Har yaushe zan zauna a Indiya?
contact.faq.items.1.answer: Ya danganta da jinyar. Gwaje-gwaje da ƙananan ayyukan jinya na iya ɗaukar 'yan kwanaki. Manyan tiyatoci, kamar maye gurbin gaɓa, yawanci suna nufin mako biyu zuwa uku, har da lokacin murmurewa kafin ku koma gida. Shirinku yana ba da tsawon zaman da ake tsammani.
contact.faq.items.2.question: Shin wani zai iya zuwa tare da ni?
contact.faq.items.2.answer: I, kuma muna ba da shawarar hakan. Dangi ko aboki zai iya tafiya a matsayin mai rakiyarku. Muna saka shi a wasiƙar gayyatar biza kuma muna nema masa ɗaki kusa da asibiti.
contact.faq.items.3.question: Yaya zan biya kuɗin jinya?
contact.faq.items.3.answer: Kuna biyan asibiti kai tsaye, bisa rubutaccen ƙiyasinsa. Wasu asibitoci suna neman ƙaramin ajiya don tanadar kwantar da ku, sauran kuma ana biya idan kun iso. Babu abin da ke ɓoye, kuma muna bayyana kowane adadi tun farko.
contact.faq.items.4.question: Me ke faruwa bayan na koma gida?
contact.faq.items.4.answer: Muna ci gaba da tuntuɓar ku. Muna shirya kiran bibiya da likitanku, muna isar da rahotanninku, kuma muna taimakawa da duk abin da kuke buƙata yayin da kuke murmurewa.
disclaimer.meta.title: Sanarwar lafiya. Medsafar India.
disclaimer.meta.description: Abin da bayanan wannan shafin yanar gizo suke, da abin da ba su ba.
disclaimer.heading: Sanarwar lafiya
disclaimer.intro: Bayanan da ke wannan shafin yanar gizo suna taimaka muku fahimtar zaɓuɓɓukanku. Ba shawarar likita ba ne kuma ba sa maye gurbin likita.
disclaimer.updated.label: An sabunta a ƙarshe
disclaimer.sections.0.heading: Ba shawarar likita ba ne
disclaimer.sections.0.body: Duk abin da ke wannan shafin yanar gizo bayani ne na gaba ɗaya. Ba zai iya la'akari da lafiyarku, rahotanninku ko tarihin lafiyarku ba. Likitan da ya duba ku ne kaɗai zai iya gaya muku jinyar da ta dace da ku.
disclaimer.sections.1.heading: Medsafar ba asibiti ba ce
disclaimer.sections.1.body: Medsafar mai sauƙaƙa tafiye-tafiyen jinya ce. Ba ma gano cuta, ba ma jinya, kuma ba ma rubuta magani. Asibitoci da likitoci masu zaman kansu ne, ba namu ba, kuma su kaɗai ne ke yanke shawara kan jinyarku da ba da ita.
disclaimer.sections.2.heading: Sakamako ya bambanta daga mutum zuwa mutum
disclaimer.sections.2.body: Lokutan murmurewa, zaman asibiti da sakamakon da aka bayyana a wannan shafin yanar gizo na yau da kullum ne, ba alƙawari ba ne. Kowane mara lafiya daban yake, kuma kowace jinya tana da haɗari. Likitanku yana bayyana su kafin ku amince da komai.
disclaimer.sections.3.heading: Bayanan likitoci
disclaimer.sections.3.body: An ɗauko bayanan likitoci daga bayanan da asibitocinsu suka bayar. Suna bayyana horo da gogewar likita; ba sa yin alƙawarin cewa wani takamaiman likita ne zai yi muku jinya. Ana zaɓar likitanku don al'amarinku bayan ƙwararren likita ya karanta rahotanninku.
disclaimer.sections.4.heading: A lokacin gaggawa
disclaimer.sections.4.body: Idan kuna buƙatar kulawar gaggawa, ku je asibiti mafi kusa ko ku kira lambar gaggawa ta yankinku. Kada ku jira amsa daga gare mu.
disclaimer.sections.5.heading: Tambayoyi
disclaimer.sections.5.body: Idan wani abu a wannan shafin yanar gizo bai bayyana ba ko yana kama da kuskure, ku sanar da mu a care@medsafar.com.
editorialPolicy.meta.title: Manufar rubutu. Medsafar India.
editorialPolicy.meta.description: Yadda Medsafar ke rubutawa, dubawa da sabunta bayanan da ke wannan shafin yanar gizo.
editorialPolicy.heading: Manufar rubutu
editorialPolicy.intro: Marasa lafiya suna yanke manyan shawarwari bisa abin da suka karanta. Ga yadda muke tabbatar da cewa abin da muke wallafawa a bayyane yake, adalci ne kuma daidai ne.
editorialPolicy.updated.label: An sabunta a ƙarshe
editorialPolicy.sections.0.heading: Kalmomi masu sauƙi
editorialPolicy.sections.0.body: Muna rubutawa ne ga marasa lafiya da iyalai, da yawa daga cikinsu suna karanta Turanci a matsayin harshe na biyu. Muna amfani da gajerun jimloli da kalmomi na yau da kullum, kuma muna bayyana duk kalmar likitanci da ba za mu iya kauce mata ba.
editorialPolicy.sections.1.heading: Likita ya duba
editorialPolicy.sections.2.heading: Majiyoyi
editorialPolicy.sections.2.body: Rubuce-rubuce suna ambaton majiyoyin da bayanansu suka fito: ƙungiyoyin likitanci, asibitoci da binciken da aka wallafa. Bayanan likitoci da asibitoci suna zuwa ne daga asibitocin kansu.
editorialPolicy.sections.3.heading: Babu alƙawura
editorialPolicy.sections.3.body: Ba ma yin alƙawarin sakamako, ba ma faɗar farashin da ba a rubuce daga asibiti ba, kuma ba ma cewa wani likita ko asibiti shi ne mafi kyau. Ƙiyasin kuɗi kullum yana zuwa ne daga asibitin da ke jinyar, don al'amarinku.
editorialPolicy.sections.4.heading: 'Yancin kai
editorialPolicy.sections.4.body: Asibitoci abokan hulɗa na iya biyan Medsafar wani kuɗi. Wannan ba ya canza abin da muke rubutawa game da jinya, kuma ba ya canza farashin da asibitin ya faɗa muku.
editorialPolicy.sections.5.heading: Sabunta bayanai
editorialPolicy.sections.5.body: Muna duba shafukanmu akai-akai da kuma lokacin da shawarar likitanci ta canza. Kowane shafin manufa yana nuna kwanan watan da aka sabunta shi a ƙarshe.
editorialPolicy.sections.6.heading: Gyare-gyare
editorialPolicy.sections.6.body: Idan kun ga kuskure, ku rubuta wa care@medsafar.com. Muna duba shi kuma mu gyara shafin da wuri-wuri.
cancellations.meta.title: Soke-soke da mayar da kuɗi. Medsafar India.
cancellations.meta.description: Abin da ke faruwa idan kun canza ko kuka soke shirinku.
cancellations.heading: Soke-soke da mayar da kuɗi
cancellations.intro: Shirye-shirye suna canzawa, wani lokaci saboda dalilan lafiya. Wannan shafi yana bayyana wanda za ku yi magana da shi da abin da ke faruwa da kuɗin da aka riga aka biya.
cancellations.updated.label: An sabunta a ƙarshe
cancellations.sections.0.heading: Shirye-shiryen jinya ba sa cin kuɗi
cancellations.sections.0.body: Ra'ayin likita, shirin jinya da ƙiyasin kuɗi kyauta ne. Kuna iya dakatarwa a kowane lokaci kafin ku yi tafiya ba tare da biyan Medsafar komai ba.
cancellations.sections.1.heading: Kuɗin ajiya na asibiti
cancellations.sections.1.body: Wasu asibitoci suna neman kuɗin ajiya don tanadar kwantar da ku. Kuna biyan asibiti, kuma ƙa'idojin asibitin ne ke yanke shawarar ko za a mayar da shi da yadda za a mayar. Muna ba ku waɗannan ƙa'idoji a rubuce kafin ku biya.
cancellations.sections.2.heading: Jiragen sama, otal-otal da biza
cancellations.sections.2.body: Kamfanonin jiragen sama da otal-otal kowanne yana da nasa ƙa'idojin soke-soke, kuma su ne ke aiki kan abin da aka yi ajiyarsa da su. Muna gaya muku ƙa'idojin kafin mu yi ajiya. Kuɗin biza da aka biya Gwamnatin Indiya ba a mayar da shi.
cancellations.sections.3.heading: Kuɗaɗen Medsafar na kanta
cancellations.sections.3.body: Idan Medsafar za ta karɓi kuɗi daga gare ku don ayyukanta, muna amincewa da adadin da sharuɗɗan mayar da kuɗi tare da ku a rubuce kafin ku biya. Duk wani mayar da kuɗi yana bin abin da muka amince.
cancellations.sections.4.heading: Idan likita ya canza shirin
cancellations.sections.4.body: Bayan ya duba ku a Indiya, likita na iya ba da shawarar wata jinya dabam ko ya yanke shawarar cewa jinyar ba ta dace da ku ba. Idan hakan ya faru, muna taimaka muku fahimtar zaɓuɓɓukanku kuma muna daidaita duk wani mayar da kuɗi da asibiti.
cancellations.sections.5.heading: Yadda ake soke
cancellations.sections.5.body: Ku sanar da mai kula da al'amarinku, ko ku rubuta wa care@medsafar.com ko WhatsApp +91 98203 22088. Muna tabbatarwa a rubuce kuma muna tuntuɓar asibiti, kamfanin jirgin sama da otal a madadinku.
questionnaireText.list.meta.title: Takardun tambayoyin tiyata. Medsafar India.
questionnaireText.list.meta.description: Ku amsa 'yan tambayoyi kafin likitan tiyata ya duba al'amarinku. Kyauta ne, kuma yana ɗaukar kusan minti uku.
questionnaireText.list.heading: Ku amsa 'yan tambayoyi da farko
questionnaireText.list.intro: Likitan tiyata yana karanta amsoshinku kafin kiran farko, don shawarar da kuka samu ta dace da al'amarinku. Yana ɗaukar kusan minti uku.
questionnaireText.contact.heading: Ina za mu aika da amsar?
questionnaireText.contact.intro: Mai kula da al'amura yana amsawa ta WhatsApp ko ta kira, da abin da likitan tiyata ke tunani.
questionnaireText.done.heading: Mun gode. Mun karɓi amsoshinku.
questionnaireText.done.body: Mai kula da al'amura na Medsafar zai tuntuɓe ku da zarar likitan tiyata ya karanta su.
questionnaireText.errors.required: Don Allah ku amsa kowace tambaya da ba a yi mata alamar ba dole ba.
questionnaireText.note: Ana amfani da amsoshinku ne kawai don shirya kulawarku. Ba gano cuta ba ne: likitan tiyata ne ke yanke shawarar abin da ya dace da ku bayan ya karanta rahotanninku kuma ya duba ku.
Takardar tambayoyin tiyatar rage ƙiba. Medsafar India.
Ku gano ko tiyatar rage ƙiba za ta iya dacewa da ku. Ku amsa 'yan tambayoyi kuma likitan tiyata a Indiya zai karanta su kyauta.
Tsawonku, nauyinku da lafiyarku cikin 'yan tambayoyi, don likitan tiyata ya gaya muku ko tiyata za ta iya dacewa da ku.
questionnaires.weight-loss-surgery.intro: Ku gaya mana game da nauyinku da lafiyarku. Likitan tiyatar rage ƙiba a asibitin abokin hulɗa yana karanta amsoshinku ya gaya muku ko tiyata za ta iya dacewa da ku.
questionnaires.weight-loss-surgery.bmi.n: BMI jagora ne na kusan-kusan. Likitocin tiyata yawanci suna la'akari da tiyatar rage ƙiba daga BMI na kusan 35, ko ƙasa da haka ga wasu mutane masu ciwon suga na nau'i na 2. Likitan tiyata ne ke yanke shawara don al'amarinku.

questionnaires.cosmetic-surgery.treatmen: Tiyatar gyaran jiki da ta kyau
questionnaires.cosmetic-surgery.meta.tit: Takardar tambayoyin tiyatar kyau. Medsafar India.
questionnaires.cosmetic-surgery.meta.des: Ku gaya wa likitan tiyatar gyaran jiki a Indiya abin da kuke son canzawa. Ku amsa 'yan tambayoyi kuma ku samu shawara kyauta don al'amarinku.
questionnaires.cosmetic-surgery.card.bod: Abin da kuke son canzawa da ɗan bayani game da lafiyarku, don likitan tiyata ya ba da shawara kafin ku yi tafiya.
questionnaires.cosmetic-surgery.heading: Takardar tambayoyin tiyatar kyau
questionnaires.cosmetic-surgery.intro: Ku gaya mana abin da kuke son canzawa da ɗan bayani game da lafiyarku. Likitan tiyatar gyaran jiki a asibitin abokin hulɗa yana karanta amsoshinku ya ba da shawara kan abin da zai yiwu.

specialities.organ-transplant.name: Dashen sashen jiki
specialities.organ-transplant.summary: Dashen ƙoda, hanta da wasu sassan jiki, sau da yawa daga ɗan uwa mai rai da ya bayar. Ƙungiyar dashe tana duba mara lafiya da mai bayarwa, kuma kwamitin asibiti yana duba takardu kafin a shirya komai.
specialities.oncology.name: Jinyar ciwon daji (oncology)
specialities.oncology.summary: Kulawar ciwon daji: tiyata, maganin chemotherapy, jinyar haske (radiation) da sababbin hanyoyin jinya. Ƙungiyar likitocin ciwon daji tana karanta rahotanni kuma tana shirya jinya tare.
specialities.haematology-bmt.name: Cututtukan jini da dashen ɓargo
specialities.haematology-bmt.summary: Kulawa don cututtukan jini da ciwon daji na jini, har da dashen ɓargo ga manya da yara.
specialities.neurology-neurosurgery.name: Cututtukan ƙwaƙwalwa da jijiyoyi da tiyatarsu
specialities.neurology-neurosurgery.summ: Kulawa da tiyata don ƙwaƙwalwa, kashin baya da jijiyoyi, daga ciwace-ciwace zuwa matsalolin motsi.
specialities.bariatric-surgery.name: Tiyatar rage ƙiba (bariatric)
specialities.bariatric-surgery.summary: Tiyatocin da ke taimaka wa mutane masu ƙiba mai tsanani su rage nauyi kuma su ci gaba da kasancewa a haka, idan tsarin abinci da motsa jiki ba su isa ba.
specialities.fertility-ivf.name: Haihuwa da IVF
specialities.fertility-ivf.summary: Taimako ga ma'aurata da ke ƙoƙarin samun ɗa, har da IVF da ICSI, bayan gwaje-gwaje ga dukansu biyu.
specialities.orthopaedics.name: Jinyar ƙashi da gaɓoɓi
specialities.orthopaedics.summary: Tiyata don ƙasusuwa da gaɓoɓi, kamar maye gurbin kwatangwalo da gwiwa da gyaran raunukan wasanni.
specialities.cardiology.name: Jinyar zuciya da tiyatar zuciya
specialities.cardiology.summary: Gwaje-gwaje, ayyukan jinya da tiyatoci don zuciya, daga angioplasty zuwa tiyatar bypass da maye gurbin bawul ɗin zuciya.
specialities.cosmetic-plastic-surgery.na: Tiyatar gyaran jiki da ta kyau
specialities.cosmetic-plastic-surgery.su: Tiyata don sake gina ko canza siffar jiki da fuska, da dashen gashi, wanda ake shiryawa bayan ganawa da likitan tiyata.
specialities.ophthalmology.name: Jinyar ido (ophthalmology)
specialities.ophthalmology.summary: Tiyata da kulawa don idanu, daga yanar ido (cataract) da LASIK zuwa jinyar ƙwayar ido (cornea), glaucoma da retina, bayan cikakken binciken ido.
specialities.dentistry.name: Jinyar haƙori
specialities.dentistry.summary: Dashen haƙori (implants), jinyar jijiyar haƙori (root canal), wayoyin gyaran haƙori da gyaran kyan haƙori, wanda ake shiryawa bayan dubawa da hoton X-ray.
treatments.kidney-transplant.name: Dashen ƙoda
treatments.kidney-transplant.summary: Tiyata da ke saka lafiyayyar ƙoda daga mai bayarwa cikin mutumin da ƙodojinsa suka daina aiki.
treatments.kidney-transplant.what: Ana saka lafiyayyar ƙoda daga mai bayarwa a ƙasan ciki kuma a haɗa ta da jijiyoyin jini da mafitsara. Yawanci ana barin ƙodojin mutumin a inda suke. Mai bayarwa galibi ɗan uwa ne mai rai; inda rukunin jini bai dace ba, dashe na musaya (paired) da wani iyali na iya sa hakan ya yiwu a wasu lokuta. Bayan haka mara lafiya yana shan magunguna kowace rana don kada jiki ya ƙi sabuwar ƙodar.
treatments.kidney-transplant.who: Mutanen da ƙodojinsu suka daina aiki (ciwon ƙoda na matakin ƙarshe), ko sun fara wankin ƙoda (dialysis) ko ba su fara ba, waɗanda ke da ƙarfin yin tiyata kuma suke da mai bayarwa da ya dace.
treatments.kidney-transplant.stay: Kusan kwana 8: 3 a sashen kulawa ta musamman da 5 a ɗakin kwanciya a Nanavati Max Super Speciality Hospital. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.kidney-transplant.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna komawa harkokin yau da kullum masu sauƙi cikin mako 4 zuwa 6. Ku shirya zama a Indiya kusan mako 4 zuwa 6 bayan tiyatar don dubawa sosai da gwaje-gwajen jini.
treatments.kidney-transplant.faq.0.quest: Shin ɗan uwa daga ƙasata zai iya zama mai bayarwa?
treatments.kidney-transplant.faq.0.answe: I. Dokar Indiya ta ba da izinin bayarwa daga makusantan dangi masu rai, kuma kwamitin ba da izini na asibiti yana duba takardun kowane mai bayarwa kafin dashen. Muna taimaka muku shirya waɗannan takardu kafin ku yi tafiya.
treatments.kidney-transplant.faq.1.quest: Idan rukunin jinin mai bayarwa bai dace da nawa ba fa?
treatments.kidney-transplant.faq.1.answe: Dashe na musaya (paired) da wani iyali, ko dashe tsakanin rukunin jini dabam-dabam tare da ƙarin jinya tun kafin lokaci, na iya yiwuwa. Ƙungiyar dashe ce ke yanke shawara bayan gwaje-gwaje.
treatments.dialysis.name: Wankin ƙoda (haemodialysis da haemodiafiltration)
treatments.dialysis.summary: Na'ura tana tace jini idan ƙodoji ba za su iya yin hakan ba, yawanci a zama na kusan awa huɗu, sau uku a mako.
treatments.dialysis.what: Ana wuce da jini ta wata matatar da ke wajen jiki wadda ke cire datti da ƙarin ruwa, sannan a mayar da shi. Haemodiafiltration hanya ce mai zurfi ta wannan jinya. Ana kuma iya yin zaman da daddare (nocturnal dialysis) ga wasu marasa lafiya.
treatments.dialysis.who: Mutanen da ƙodojinsu suka daina aiki, har da masu jiran dashe, da marasa lafiya da suka riga suna wankin ƙoda waɗanda ke buƙatarsa yayin da suke Indiya don jinya.
treatments.dialysis.stay: Yawanci ana yi ba tare da kwanciya ba: kuna zuwa don kowane zama kuma ku koma gida a ranar.
treatments.dialysis.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna jin gajiya na 'yan awoyi bayan zama. Wankin ƙoda yana ci gaba muddin ƙodoji ba sa aiki, ko har sai an yi dashe.
treatments.dialysis.faq.0.question: Na riga ina wankin ƙoda. Zan iya ci gaba da shi a Indiya?
treatments.dialysis.faq.0.answer: I. Ku aiko mana da bayanan wankin ƙodarku na yanzu kuma za mu yi muku ajiyar zama a asibiti na duk tsawon zamanku.
treatments.dialysis.faq.1.question: Shin wankin ƙoda yana maye gurbin dashe?
treatments.dialysis.faq.1.answer: A'a. Wankin ƙoda yana yin wani ɓangare na aikin ƙodoji. Dashe, inda ya dace, yawanci yana ba da ingantacciyar rayuwa. Likitan ƙoda ne zai ba da shawarar wanda ya dace da ku.
treatments.liver-transplant.name: Dashen hanta
treatments.liver-transplant.summary: Tiyata da ke maye gurbin hantar da ke lalacewa da duka ko wani ɓangare na lafiyayyar hanta daga mai bayarwa.
treatments.liver-transplant.what: Ana cire hantar da ke da cuta a maye gurbinta da lafiyayya. A dashe daga mai bayarwa mai rai, ɗan uwa yana bayar da wani ɓangare na hantarsa; ɓangarorin biyu suna sake girma kusan zuwa cikakken girmansu cikin makonni. A dashe daga mamaci, ana amfani da cikakkiyar hanta.
treatments.liver-transplant.who: Mutanen da hantarsu ta lalace saboda cirrhosis, ciwon hanta (hepatitis), barasa ko kitse a hanta, wasu ciwon daji na hanta, ko wasu cututtukan gado da ba a cika samu ba, a manya da yara.
treatments.liver-transplant.stay: Kusan kwana 21 a Nanavati Max Super Speciality Hospital. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.liver-transplant.recovery: Ku shirya zama a Indiya kusan wata 2 zuwa 3 gaba ɗaya. Yawancin mutane suna komawa rayuwar yau da kullum cikin wata 3 zuwa 6, kuma suna shan magungunan hana ƙin sashen jiki har abada.
treatments.liver-transplant.faq.0.questi: Har yaushe mai bayarwa mai rai yake zama a asibiti?
treatments.liver-transplant.faq.0.answer: Yawanci kusan kwana 7 zuwa 10, kuma yawancin masu bayarwa suna komawa rayuwar yau da kullum cikin mako 6 zuwa 8.
treatments.liver-transplant.faq.1.questi: Waɗanne gwaje-gwaje ake buƙata kafin mu yi tafiya?
treatments.liver-transplant.faq.1.answer: Ku aiko mana da rahotanni na baya-bayan nan, hotunan na'ura da gwaje-gwajen jini na mara lafiya, da rukunin jinin masu yiwuwar bayarwa. Ƙungiyar dashe za ta gaya muku abin da kuma ake buƙata.
treatments.pancreas-transplant.name: Dashen saifa (pancreas)
treatments.pancreas-transplant.summary: Tiyata da ke saka lafiyayyar saifa (pancreas) daga mai bayarwa cikin mutum mai ciwon suga, don jikinsa ya sake samar da insulin da kansa. Sau da yawa ana yin ta tare da dashen ƙoda.
treatments.pancreas-transplant.what: Ana saka saifa (pancreas) daga mamaci a ƙasan ciki kuma a haɗa ta da jijiyoyin jini da hanji ko mafitsara. Saifar mutumin tana zama a wurinta. Idan sabuwar saifar ta yi aiki, ba a sake buƙatar allurar insulin. Sau da yawa ana yin ta a lokaci ɗaya da dashen ƙoda.
treatments.pancreas-transplant.who: Galibi mutane masu ciwon suga na nau'i na 1: waɗanda ba sa ƙara jin alamun gargaɗin raguwar sugar jini mai haɗari (hypoglycaemia unawareness), waɗanda ke samun lalacewar ƙoda, jijiyoyi ko idanu duk da insulin, da waɗanda kuma suke da ciwon ƙoda na dogon lokaci. Wasu mutane masu ciwon suga na nau'i na 2 ma sun dace. Ciwon suga tare da ciwon ƙoda abu ne mai tsanani: haɗarin mutuwa ya ninka kusan sau biyu na ciwon ƙoda shi kaɗai, matsakaicin tsawon rayuwa kusan shekara 4 zuwa 5 ne, kuma ana rasa kusan shekara 16 na rayuwa.
treatments.pancreas-transplant.stay: Yawanci kusan mako 2 zuwa 3 a asibiti, fiye da haka idan an yi tare da dashen ƙoda. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.pancreas-transplant.recovery: Ku shirya zama a Indiya kusan wata 2 zuwa 3. Ana shan magungunan hana ƙin sashen jiki har abada.
treatments.pancreas-transplant.faq.0.ans: I. Saifar tana zuwa ne daga mamaci, don haka akwai jerin jira. Ƙungiyar za ta bayyana yadda yake aiki ga marasa lafiya na ƙasashen waje.
treatments.pancreas-transplant.faq.1.que: Shin har yanzu zan buƙaci insulin?
treatments.pancreas-transplant.faq.1.ans: Idan sabuwar saifar ta yi aiki da kyau, a'a. Likitocinku suna duba sugar jininku sosai a makonnin farko.
treatments.intestine-transplant.name: Dashen hanji
treatments.intestine-transplant.summary: Tiyata da ke maye gurbin ƙaramin hanjin da ya daina aiki ko aka rasa da lafiyayyen hanji daga mai bayarwa.
treatments.intestine-transplant.what: Ana haɗa ƙaramin hanji daga mai bayarwa da jijiyoyin jini da hanjin mara lafiya, don ya sake iya shan abinci kuma ya daina ciyarwa ta ƙarin ruwa (drip). Yana ɗaya daga cikin dashe mafi sarƙaƙiya kuma yana buƙatar bibiya ta kusa ta tsawon lokaci.
treatments.intestine-transplant.who: A yara, gazawar hanji bayan necrotising enterocolitis (NEC), gastroschisis ko matsalar motsin hanji. A manya, rasa hanji saboda mesenteric ischaemia (toshewar hanyar jini), midgut volvulus (murɗewar hanji) ko ciwace-ciwacen mesentery.
treatments.intestine-transplant.stay: Yawanci mako 4 zuwa 8 a asibiti. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.intestine-transplant.recovery: Ku shirya zama a Indiya kusan wata 3 ko fiye. Ana dawo da cin abinci a hankali, kuma ana shan magungunan hana ƙin sashen jiki har abada.
treatments.intestine-transplant.faq.0.qu: Wa ya dace da shi idan ana ciyar da ni ta drip a gida?
treatments.intestine-transplant.faq.0.an: Mutanen da suka dogara da ciyarwa ta drip (parenteral nutrition) kuma suke samun matsaloli da ita, kamar lalacewar hanta ko kamuwa da cuta a bututun drip akai-akai, yawanci ana duba su don dashe.
treatments.intestine-transplant.faq.1.qu: Yara za su iya yin sa?
treatments.intestine-transplant.faq.1.an: I. Ana yin dashen hanji da yawa ga yara. Ƙungiyar tana duba kowane yaro daban.
treatments.hand-transplant.name: Dashen hannu
treatments.hand-transplant.summary: Tiyata da ke haɗa hannu ɗaya ko duka biyu daga mamaci ga mutumin da ya rasa nasa, ta hanyar haɗa ƙashi, jijiyoyin jini, jijiyoyin tsoka, jijiyoyin ji da fata.
treatments.hand-transplant.what: Dashen hannu yana motsa fata, tsoka, jijiyar tsoka, ƙashi, jijiyoyin jini da jijiyoyin ji tare, shi ya sa ake kiransa dashen nama mai haɗaka (composite tissue transplant). Likitocin tiyata suna gyara ƙasusuwa, haɗa jijiyoyin jini, gyara jijiyoyin tsoka da haɗa jijiyoyin ji. Bayan haka mara lafiya yana shan magani don hana jiki ƙin sababbin hannayen, kuma yana yin jinyar motsa jiki ta tsawon lokaci. Idan ya yi nasara, dashen hannu na iya dawo da ji, sanin matsayin hannu da motsi mai tsari fiye da abin da hannun roba zai iya bayarwa.
treatments.hand-transplant.who: Mutanen da suka rasa hannu ɗaya ko duka biyu ko damatsa, bayan gwaje-gwaje masu zurfi na lafiya, na ƙwaƙwalwa da na garkuwar jiki. Dole a samu mai bayarwa da ya dace, don haka yawanci akwai lokacin jira.
treatments.hand-transplant.stay: Yawanci kusan mako 3 zuwa 4 a asibiti. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.hand-transplant.recovery: Ku shirya zama a Indiya kusan wata 3 zuwa 6 don jinyar hannu ta kullum. Motsi da ji suna ci gaba da inganta tsawon shekara ɗaya zuwa biyu yayin da jijiyoyi ke girma.
treatments.hand-transplant.faq.0.questio: Yaushe zan iya amfani da sabon hannun?
treatments.hand-transplant.faq.0.answer: Motsi masu sauƙi yawanci suna farawa cikin makonni. Ji da ingantaccen iko suna dawowa a hankali tsawon watanni, tare da jinya ta kullum.
treatments.hand-transplant.faq.1.questio: Shin zan buƙaci magunguna har abada?
treatments.hand-transplant.faq.1.answer: I. Kamar kowane dashe, yana buƙatar magungunan hana ƙin sashen jiki kowace rana, da dubawa akai-akai.
treatments.bone-marrow-transplant.name: Dashen ɓargo (dashen ƙwayoyin halitta na stem cell)
treatments.bone-marrow-transplant.summar: Jinyar da ke maye gurbin ɓargon da ya lalace ko ke da cuta da lafiyayyun ƙwayoyin stem cell masu samar da jini, ana amfani da ita don wasu ciwon daji na jini da cututtukan jini.
treatments.bone-marrow-transplant.what: Da farko, maganin chemotherapy mai ƙarfi, wani lokaci tare da jinyar haske (radiation), yana share ɓargon da ke da cuta. Sannan ana ba da lafiyayyun ƙwayoyin stem cell ta drip, kamar ƙarin jini, kuma suna zama a cikin ƙasusuwa su samar da sabon jini. Ƙwayoyin suna zuwa daga mara lafiyar kansa (autologous), daga mai bayarwa da ya dace (allogeneic), ko daga ɗan uwa da ya dace rabi (haploidentical), wanda ke nufin yawancin marasa lafiya za su iya samun mai bayarwa.
treatments.bone-marrow-transplant.who: Mutane masu wasu ciwon daji na jini, kamar leukaemia, lymphoma da myeloma, da wasu cututtukan jini, kamar thalassaemia, sikila (sickle cell) da aplastic anaemia, a manya da yara.
treatments.bone-marrow-transplant.stay: Kusan kwana 30 a Nanavati Max Super Speciality Hospital. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.bone-marrow-transplant.recove: Ku shirya zama a Indiya kusan wata 2 zuwa 3 bayan dashen don bibiya ta kusa. Garkuwar jiki tana ɗaukar wata 6 zuwa 12 kafin ta murmure gaba ɗaya.
Wa zai iya zama mai bayarwa gare ni?

Ana fara duba ɗan uwa ko 'yar uwa. Idan babu wanda ya dace gaba ɗaya, iyaye, ɗa ko ɗan uwa da ya dace rabi sau da yawa zai iya bayarwa. Ana yin gwaje-gwaje kafin ku yi tafiya ko jim kaɗan bayan kun iso.
Shin mai bayarwa yana buƙatar tiyata?
Yawanci a'a. Yawancin ƙwayoyin stem cell a yau ana tattara su daga jinin mai bayarwa ta drip, cikin 'yan awoyi.
treatments.car-t-cell-therapy.summary: Ana tattara ƙwayoyin garkuwar jikin mara lafiyar kansa, a canza su a ɗakin gwaje-gwaje don su gane ciwon dajinsa, sannan a mayar masa da su ta drip. Ana amfani da ita don wasu leukaemia, lymphoma da myeloma.
treatments.car-t-cell-therapy.what: Ana tattara fararen ƙwayoyin jini da ake kira T cells daga jinin mara lafiya. A ɗakin gwaje-gwaje ana ba su sabon mai karɓa (CAR) da ke taimaka musu nemo ciwon dajin su kai masa hari. Bayan ɗan gajeren lokacin chemotherapy, ana mayar da ƙwayoyin ta drip, inda suke ƙaruwa suna yaƙi da ciwon dajin.
treatments.car-t-cell-therapy.who: Manya da wasu yara masu wasu nau'o'in leukaemia, lymphoma ko multiple myeloma da suka dawo ko ba su amsa wata jinya ba.
treatments.car-t-cell-therapy.stay: Yawanci kusan mako 2 a asibiti bayan an ba da ƙwayoyin. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.car-t-cell-therapy.recovery: Ku shirya zama kusa da asibiti kusan mako 4 bayan an ba da ƙwayoyin, domin illoli kamar zazzaɓi na iya bayyana a wannan lokaci. Yawancin mutane suna komawa gida cikin wata 1 zuwa 2.
treatments.car-t-cell-therapy.faq.0.ques: Har yaushe ake ɗauka kafin a yi ƙwayoyin?
treatments.car-t-cell-therapy.faq.0.answ: Yawanci 'yan makonni daga tattarawa zuwa bayarwa. Likitanku na iya ba da wata jinya yayin da kuke jira.
treatments.car-t-cell-therapy.faq.1.answ: Zazzaɓi, ƙarancin hawan jini kuma, wani lokaci, ruɗani a makonnin farko. Ƙungiyar tana sa ido sosai kuma tana jinyar su da wuri.
treatments.childhood-cancer-treatment.na: Jinyar ciwon daji da cututtukan jini na yara
treatments.childhood-cancer-treatment.su: Kulawa ga yara masu leukaemia, lymphoma, ciwace-ciwace masu ƙarfi da cututtukan jini marasa ciwon daji, wanda likitocin da ke jinyar yara kaɗai ke shiryawa.
treatments.childhood-cancer-treatment.wh: Likitan cututtukan jini da ciwon daji na yara (paediatric haemato-oncologist) yana shirya dukan jinyar, wadda za ta iya haɗa chemotherapy, tiyata, jinyar haske (radiotherapy) da dashen ɓargo. Adadin magani da kulawa sun dace da yaro mai girma, tare da tallafi ga iyali a duk tsawon lokacin.
Yara masu ciwon daji na jini kamar leukaemia da lymphoma, ciwace-ciwace masu ƙarfi, ko cututtukan jini kamar thalassaemia da aplastic anaemia.
treatments.childhood-cancer-treatment.st: Ya danganta da shirin jinya. Yawancin zaman chemotherapy ana yi ne ba tare da kwanciya ba; dashen ɓargo yana buƙatar kusan wata ɗaya a asibiti.
treatments.childhood-cancer-treatment.re: Jinya sau da yawa tana ɗaukar watanni da dama. Likita zai bayyana waɗanne sassa dole a yi su a Indiya da waɗanda za a iya ci gaba da su a gida.
treatments.childhood-cancer-treatment.fa: Shin ɗaya daga cikin iyaye zai iya zama tare da yaron?
I. Ɗaya daga cikin iyaye zai iya zama tare da yaron a asibiti. Muna taimakawa da masauki kusa ga sauran iyalin.
Shin wani ɓangare na jinyar zai iya ci gaba a gida?
Sau da yawa, i. Likita zai iya raba shirin da likitanku na gida don sassan da za a iya yi a gida lafiya.
treatments.chemotherapy.name: Chemotherapy (maganin kashe ƙwayoyin ciwon daji)
treatments.chemotherapy.summary: Magungunan da ke kashe ƙwayoyin ciwon daji ko hana su girma, ana ba da su ta drip, allura ko ƙwaya a jerin zama.
treatments.chemotherapy.what: Likitan ciwon daji (medical oncologist) yana zaɓar magunguna, adadi da lokaci bisa irin ciwon dajin da matakinsa. Yawanci ana ba da jinyar a zagaye-zagaye, tare da makonnin hutu a tsakani don jiki ya murmure. Ana iya ba da ita kafin tiyata don rage girman ciwace, bayan tiyata don rage yiwuwar dawowarsa, ko ita kaɗai.
treatments.chemotherapy.who: Mutane masu nau'o'in ciwon daji da yawa, har da na nono, huhu, hanji, mahaifar ƙwai (ovary), kai da wuya, jini da ƙashi. Likitan ciwon dajinku ne zai yanke shawarar ko ya dace da al'amarinku.
treatments.chemotherapy.stay: Yawancin zama ana yi ne ba tare da kwanciya ba: kuna zuwa, a ba ku drip ɗin, sannan ku koma gida a ranar.
treatments.chemotherapy.recovery: Gajiya da sauran illoli yawanci suna sauƙi cikin kwanaki zuwa makonni bayan kowane zagaye. Cikakken jinya sau da yawa tana ɗaukar wata 3 zuwa 6.
treatments.chemotherapy.faq.0.question: Shin dole in zauna a Indiya har ƙarshen jinyar?
treatments.chemotherapy.faq.0.answer: Ba koyaushe ba. Sau da yawa ana ba da zagayen farko a Indiya kuma sauran za a iya ci gaba da su a gida, tare da raba shirin da likitan ciwon dajinku na gida.
treatments.chemotherapy.faq.1.question: Shin gashina zai zube?
treatments.chemotherapy.faq.1.answer: Da wasu magunguna, i, kuma yawanci yana sake fitowa bayan jinya. Yawancin magungunan zamani ba sa sa zubewar gashi.
treatments.targeted-therapy-immunotherap: Jinyar da ke kai hari kai tsaye (targeted therapy) da jinyar garkuwar jiki (immunotherapy)
Sababbin magungunan ciwon daji da ke kai hari kan wani rauni na musamman a cikin ciwon dajin, ko suke taimaka wa garkuwar jiki ta yaƙe shi.

Gwaje-gwaje a kan ciwace suna neman canje-canje a ƙwayoyin halittarsa (genes) ko sunadaransa (proteins). Magungunan targeted therapy suna toshe waɗannan canje-canje, don haka suna aiki galibi a kan ƙwayoyin ciwon daji. Immunotherapy tana taimaka wa garkuwar jiki ta gane ciwon dajin ta kai masa hari. Ana kiran waɗannan da precision ko molecular oncology, kuma ana ba da su ta drip ko a matsayin ƙwayoyi.
Mutanen da ciwon dajinsu ya nuna canjin da ya dace a gwaji, ko waɗanda aka san irin ciwon dajinsu yana amsawa, kamar wasu ciwon daji na huhu, nono, ƙoda, hanji, fata da kai da wuya.
Yawanci ba tare da kwanciya ba, ko ƙwayoyin da ake sha a gida.
Yawancin mutane suna ci gaba da rayuwarsu ta yau da kullum lokacin jinya, tare da dubawa da hotunan na'ura akai-akai.
Ta yaya zan san ko ya dace da ni?
Likitan ciwon dajinku yana duba sakamakon gwajin ciwacenku. Idan ba a yi gwajin ba, sau da yawa ana iya yin sa a kan samfurin nama (biopsy) da kuke da shi.
A'a. Yana aiki ta wata hanya dabam kuma yawanci yana da illoli dabam, sau da yawa masu sauƙi. Wani lokaci ana ba da shi tare da chemotherapy.
treatments.radiation-therapy.summary: Jinyar da ke amfani da hasken makamashi mai ƙarfi da aka nufa a hankali don lalata ƙwayoyin ciwon daji a wani sashe na jiki.
treatments.radiation-therapy.what: Hoton na'ura na tsarawa yana zana taswirar ciwacen, sannan na'ura tana nufar hasken zuwa gare shi daga kusurwoyi da dama, tana kare lafiyayyen naman da ke kewaye gwargwadon iko. Kowane zama yana ɗaukar mintuna kuma ba ya ciwo. Yawanci ana ba da jinyar a ranakun aiki na mako ɗaya zuwa makonni da dama.
treatments.radiation-therapy.who: Mutane masu nau'o'in ciwon daji da yawa, ita kaɗai ko tare da tiyata da chemotherapy, kuma wani lokaci don rage ciwo daga ciwon dajin da ya yaɗu.
treatments.radiation-therapy.stay: Yawanci ba a kwanciya a asibiti: kuna zuwa don kowane ɗan gajeren zama.
treatments.radiation-therapy.recovery: Gajiya da ciwon fata a wurin da aka yi jinyar abu ne da aka saba, kuma yawanci suna lafawa cikin 'yan makonni bayan jinyar.
treatments.radiation-therapy.faq.0.quest: Shin zan zama mai fitar da haske mai guba (radioactive)?
treatments.radiation-therapy.faq.0.answe: A'a. Da jinyar haske daga waje (external beam radiotherapy) ba ku zama radioactive ba, kuma babu haɗari ku kasance tare da iyali.
treatments.radiation-therapy.faq.1.quest: Har yaushe zan buƙaci zama a Indiya?
treatments.radiation-therapy.faq.1.answe: Muddin jinyar ta ɗauka, yawanci mako 1 zuwa 7, da 'yan kwanaki don tsarawa. Likitanku zai gaya muku ainihin tsawon lokacin.
treatments.cancer-surgery.name: Tiyatar ciwon daji (surgical oncology)
treatments.cancer-surgery.summary: Tiyata don cire ciwace kuma, inda ake buƙata, naman da ke kusa ko ƙwayoyin lymph.
treatments.cancer-surgery.what: Likitan tiyatar ciwon daji yana cire ciwacen tare da ɗan lafiyayyen nama a gefensa, kuma sau da yawa ƙwayoyin lymph na kusa don duba ko ya yaɗu. Inda ya dace da al'amarin, ana yin ta ta ƙaramar huda (laparoscopic) ko ta na'urar robot, wanda yawanci ke nufin ƙananan yanka da saurin murmurewa. Ana bincika naman da aka cire don shirya duk wata ƙarin jinya.
treatments.cancer-surgery.who: Mutane masu ciwace-ciwace masu ƙarfi, kamar ciwon daji na kai da wuya, nono, ciki, hanji, hanta, saifa (pancreas), ƙoda, mafitsara, prostate, mahaifa, mahaifar ƙwai (ovary), ƙashi da nama mai laushi.
treatments.cancer-surgery.stay: Yawanci kwana 2 zuwa 10 a asibiti, ya danganta da tiyatar. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.cancer-surgery.recovery: Daga mako 2 don ƙananan tiyatoci zuwa mako 6 zuwa 8 don manya. Ku shirya zama a Indiya har sai an duba ɗinkin kuma an tattauna rahoton.
treatments.cancer-surgery.faq.0.question: Shin zan buƙaci wata jinya bayan tiyata?
treatments.cancer-surgery.faq.0.answer: Wani lokaci. Rahoton naman da aka cire yana nuna ko chemotherapy ko radiotherapy za su taimaka. Ƙungiyar tana tattauna wannan da ku kafin ku koma gida.
treatments.cancer-surgery.faq.1.question: Shin za a iya yin ta da na'urar robot?
treatments.cancer-surgery.faq.1.answer: Ga nau'o'in ciwon daji da yawa, i. Likitan tiyata ne ke yanke shawara bisa ciwacen da hotunan na'urarku.
treatments.head-neck-cancer-surgery.name: Tiyatar ciwon daji na kai da wuya
treatments.head-neck-cancer-surgery.summ: Tiyata don ciwon daji na baki, harshe, maƙogwaro, akwatin murya, gland ɗin yawu da sinus, tare da kiyaye magana da haɗiya gwargwadon iko.
treatments.head-neck-cancer-surgery.what: Ana cire ciwacen, sau da yawa tare da ƙwayoyin lymph na wuya. Inda ya dace da al'amarin, ana yin ta ta baki da laser ko na'urar robot (transoral surgery), ba tare da manyan yanka ba. Idan akwatin murya ya shafu, ana zaɓar tiyatar da ke kiyaye murya inda zai yiwu, kuma ana ba da gyaran murya idan ba zai yiwu ba. Ana iya sake gina wurin a tiyatar guda.
treatments.head-neck-cancer-surgery.who: Mutane masu ciwon daji na baki, harshe, kunci, maƙogwaro, akwatin murya (larynx), gland ɗin yawu, hanci ko sinus.
treatments.head-neck-cancer-surgery.stay: Yawanci kwana 3 zuwa 10 a asibiti, fiye da haka idan ana buƙatar sake gini. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.head-neck-cancer-surgery.reco: Yawanci mako 3 zuwa 6. Ana iya buƙatar jinyar magana da haɗiya. Wani lokaci ana ba da radiotherapy bayan haka.
Shin zan iya magana da cin abinci kamar yadda na saba?
Likitan tiyata yana ƙoƙarin kiyaye magana da haɗiya gwargwadon iko, kuma masu jinya suna taimaka muku dawo da su bayan tiyata.
Tiyata ce da ake yi ta baki a buɗe ta amfani da hannayen robot ko laser, don haka babu yanka a fuska ko wuya don ciwacen kansa.
treatments.thyroid-surgery.summary: Tiyata don cire wani ɓangare ko dukan gland ɗin thyroid ko gland ɗin parathyroid a wuya, saboda ciwon daji, manyan ƙulle-ƙulle ko gland masu aiki fiye da kima.
treatments.thyroid-surgery.what: Ta wata ƙaramar yanka a gaban wuya, likitan tiyata yana cire rabi ko dukan gland ɗin thyroid, ko gland ɗin parathyroid mai aiki fiye da kima, yana kula don kare jijiyoyin da ke zuwa akwatin murya. Idan an cire dukan thyroid, ƙwaya ta kullum tana maye gurbin sinadarinsa (hormone).
treatments.thyroid-surgery.who: Mutane masu ciwon daji na thyroid, ƙulle-ƙullen thyroid masu girma ko masu shakku, thyroid mai aiki fiye da kima da bai lafa da magani ba, ko gland ɗin parathyroid mai aiki fiye da kima.
treatments.thyroid-surgery.stay: Yawanci kwana 1 zuwa 3 a asibiti. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.thyroid-surgery.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum cikin mako 1 zuwa 2.
treatments.thyroid-surgery.faq.0.answer: Da wuya. Likitan tiyata yana kare jijiyoyin murya, kuma duk wani dashewar murya bayan tiyata yawanci yana lafawa cikin makonni.
treatments.thyroid-surgery.faq.1.questio: Shin zan buƙaci ƙwayoyi bayan haka?
treatments.thyroid-surgery.faq.1.answer: Idan an cire dukan thyroid, i, ƙwayar sinadarin thyroid ta kullum har abada. Idan an cire rabi, sau da yawa a'a.
treatments.breast-cancer-surgery.name: Tiyatar ciwon daji na nono
treatments.breast-cancer-surgery.summary: Tiyata don cire ciwon daji na nono, tare da kiyaye nonon ko sake gina shi gwargwadon iko.
treatments.breast-cancer-surgery.what: Inda babu haɗari, ciwacen da ɗan nama a kewayensa kaɗai ake cirewa (breast-conserving surgery), kuma ana gyara siffar nonon a tiyatar guda (oncoplastic surgery). Inda dole a cire dukan nonon (mastectomy), sau da yawa ana iya sake gina shi. Ana duba ƙwayoyin lymph na hammata, yawanci da ƙaramar tiyatar ɗaukar samfur. Ana iya amfani da vacuum-assisted biopsy don gano ko cire ƙananan ƙulle-ƙulle ba tare da buɗaɗɗiyar tiyata ba.
treatments.breast-cancer-surgery.who: Mata, kuma lokaci-lokaci maza, masu ciwon daji na nono, da mutane masu tarihin iyali mai ƙarfi da gwajin ƙwayoyin halitta (genetic testing) zai iya amfanar su.
treatments.breast-cancer-surgery.stay: Yawanci kwana 1 zuwa 3 a asibiti, fiye da haka tare da sake gini. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.breast-cancer-surgery.recover: Yawanci mako 2 zuwa 4. Chemotherapy, radiotherapy ko ƙwayoyin hormone na iya biyo baya, ya danganta da rahoton.
treatments.breast-cancer-surgery.faq.0.a: Sau da yawa, i, musamman idan ciwacen ƙarami ne idan aka kwatanta da nonon, ko bayan chemotherapy ta rage girmansa. Likitan tiyata zai ba da shawara bayan ya duba hotunan na'urarku.
treatments.breast-cancer-surgery.faq.1.q: Shin ya kamata in yi gwajin ƙwayoyin halitta?
treatments.breast-cancer-surgery.faq.1.a: Idan an gano cutar a lokacin da kuke matashiya ko kuna da makusantan dangi masu ciwon daji na nono ko na mahaifar ƙwai (ovary), gwajin na iya taimakawa wajen shirya jinyarku. Likita zai ba da shawara.
treatments.hpb-cancer-surgery.name: Tiyatar ciwon daji na hanta, saifa (pancreas) da hanyar bile (har da Whipple)
treatments.hpb-cancer-surgery.summary: Tiyata don cire ciwon daji na hanta, saifa (pancreas), hanyar bile da jakar bile (gall bladder), har da tiyatar Whipple don saifa.
treatments.hpb-cancer-surgery.what: Ana iya cire wani ɓangare na hanta lafiya, kuma abin da ya rage yana sake girma. Don ciwon daji a kan saifa (pancreas), tiyatar Whipple (pancreaticoduodenectomy) tana cire shi tare da wani ɓangare na hanji da hanyar bile, sannan ta sake haɗa su. Inda ciwace-ciwace suka shafi manyan jijiyoyin jini, ana iya cire su kuma a sake gina su a tiyatar guda. Yawancin waɗannan tiyatoci ana iya yin su ta ƙaramar huda ko ta na'urar robot.
treatments.hpb-cancer-surgery.who: Mutane masu ciwon daji na hanta, hanyar bile, jakar bile ko saifa (pancreas), da ciwon dajin da ya yaɗu zuwa hanta daga hanji, bayan hotunan na'ura sun nuna ana iya cire ciwacen.
treatments.hpb-cancer-surgery.stay: Yawanci kwana 7 zuwa 14 a asibiti. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.hpb-cancer-surgery.recovery: Yawanci mako 6 zuwa 8. Ku shirya zama a Indiya kusan mako 3 zuwa 4 bayan tiyata.
treatments.hpb-cancer-surgery.faq.0.ques: Shin zan iya rayuwa ta yau da kullum bayan an cire wani ɓangare na hantata?
treatments.hpb-cancer-surgery.faq.0.answ: I. Hanta tana sake girma kusan zuwa cikakken girmanta cikin makonni, muddin ɓangaren da ya rage lafiyayye ne.
treatments.hpb-cancer-surgery.faq.1.answ: Tiyata ce da ke cire kan saifa (pancreas), wani ɓangare na ƙaramin hanji, jakar bile da wani ɓangare na hanyar bile, sannan ta sake haɗa su. Ita ce babbar tiyata don ciwon daji a wannan wuri.
treatments.gi-cancer-surgery.name: Tiyatar ciwon daji na ciki, hanji da hanyar abinci
treatments.gi-cancer-surgery.summary: Tiyata don cire ciwon daji na hanyar abinci (oesophagus), ciki, ƙaramin hanji, babban hanji (colon) da dubura (rectum).
treatments.gi-cancer-surgery.what: Ana cire ɓangaren hanjin da ke da ciwon dajin tare da ƙwayoyin lymph ɗinsa, kuma a sake haɗa ƙarshensa. Yawancin waɗannan tiyatoci ana iya yin su ta ƙaramar huda ko ta na'urar robot. Don ciwon daji na dubura, likitan tiyata yana ƙoƙarin kiyaye ikon riƙe bayan gida na yau da kullum gwargwadon iko.
treatments.gi-cancer-surgery.who: Mutane masu ciwon daji na hanyar abinci (oesophagus), ciki, ƙaramin hanji, babban hanji (colon) ko dubura (rectum), da wasu ciwace-ciwacen ciki kamar sarcoma.
treatments.gi-cancer-surgery.stay: Yawanci kwana 5 zuwa 10 a asibiti. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.gi-cancer-surgery.recovery: Yawanci mako 4 zuwa 8. Cin abinci yana dawowa a hankali, tare da shawara daga masanin abinci mai gina jiki.
treatments.gi-cancer-surgery.faq.0.answe: Ba koyaushe ba. Wani lokaci stoma na ɗan lokaci yana kare haɗin yayin da yake warkewa, kuma ana rufe shi bayan 'yan watanni. Likitan tiyata zai gaya muku kafin tiyatar.
treatments.gi-cancer-surgery.faq.1.answe: Sau da yawa, kafin ko bayan tiyata, ya danganta da matakin cutar. Ƙungiyar tana shirya ta tare.
treatments.hipec.name: Tiyatar cytoreductive da HIPEC
treatments.hipec.summary: Tiyata da ke cire dukan ciwon dajin da ake gani daga cikin ciki, sannan a wanke cikin da chemotherapy mai ɗumi a tiyatar guda.
treatments.hipec.what: Likitan tiyata yana cire kowace ciwace da ake gani daga bangon cikin ciki (cytoreductive surgery). Sannan, yayin da ake har yanzu a ɗakin tiyata, ana zagaya chemotherapy mai ɗumi a cikin ciki na kusan awa ɗaya (HIPEC) don jinyar ƙwayoyin ciwon daji da suka yi ƙanƙanta da ba a gani. Ɗumi yana taimaka wa maganin ya yi aiki sosai, kuma kaɗan daga cikinsa ne ke kaiwa sauran jiki.
treatments.hipec.who: Zaɓaɓɓun mutane masu ciwon dajin da ya yaɗu zuwa bangon cikin ciki (peritoneum) daga mahaifar ƙwai (ovary), hanji, appendix ko ciki, da mutane masu peritoneal mesothelioma ko pseudomyxoma.
treatments.hipec.stay: Yawanci kwana 10 zuwa 14 a asibiti, tare da 'yan kwanaki a sashen kulawa ta musamman. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.hipec.recovery: Yawanci mako 6 zuwa 12. Ku shirya zama a Indiya kusan mako 4 bayan tiyata.
treatments.hipec.faq.0.question: Shin kowa da ciwon dajinsa ya yaɗu zuwa ciki ya dace?
treatments.hipec.faq.0.answer: A'a. Ƙungiyar tana duba hotunan na'urarku da lafiyarku don ganin ko za a iya cire dukan ciwon dajin da ake gani, domin a lokacin ne HIPEC ta fi taimakawa.
treatments.hipec.faq.1.question: Shin tiyata ce mai tsawo?
treatments.hipec.faq.1.answer: I, sau da yawa awa 8 zuwa 12. Ana yin ta ne kawai a cibiyoyi na musamman masu gogaggun ƙungiyoyi.
treatments.urologic-cancer-surgery.name: Tiyatar ciwon daji na ƙoda, mafitsara da prostate
treatments.urologic-cancer-surgery.summa: Tiyata don ciwon daji na ƙoda, mafitsara, prostate, ƙwalatai (testis) da gland ɗin adrenal, sau da yawa da na'urar robot.
treatments.urologic-cancer-surgery.what: Ya danganta da ciwon dajin, likitan tiyata yana cire ciwacen tare da wani ɓangare na ƙoda (yana barin sauran yana aiki) ko dukan ƙodar, prostate, ko mafitsara. Idan an cire mafitsara, ana yin sabuwar hanyar fitar da fitsari, wani lokaci sabuwar mafitsara daga hanji. Ana amfani da tiyatar robot inda ta dace, kuma likitan tiyata yana ƙoƙarin kiyaye ikon riƙe fitsari da aikin jima'i gwargwadon iko.
treatments.urologic-cancer-surgery.who: Mutane masu ciwon daji na ƙoda, mafitsara, prostate, ƙwalatai (testis), azzakari ko gland ɗin adrenal.
treatments.urologic-cancer-surgery.stay: Yawanci kwana 3 zuwa 10 a asibiti, ya danganta da tiyatar. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.urologic-cancer-surgery.faq.0: Shin za a iya kiyaye wani ɓangare na ƙodata?
Sau da yawa, don ƙananan ciwace-ciwace. Cire ciwacen kaɗai (partial nephrectomy) yana kiyaye ƙarin aikin ƙoda.
treatments.urologic-cancer-surgery.faq.1: Shin tiyatar prostate za ta shafi ikon riƙe fitsari?
Ɗan zubar fitsari abu ne da aka saba da farko kuma yawanci yana inganta cikin makonni zuwa watanni, tare da motsa jiki. Likitan tiyata zai bayyana haɗarin da ya shafe ku.
treatments.gynaecologic-cancer-surgery.n: Tiyatar ciwon daji na mahaifar ƙwai (ovary), mahaifa da bakin mahaifa
treatments.gynaecologic-cancer-surgery.s: Tiyata don ciwon daji na mahaifar ƙwai (ovary), mahaifa (uterus), bakin mahaifa (cervix) da farji na waje (vulva), tare da kiyaye ikon haihuwa inda babu haɗari.
treatments.gynaecologic-cancer-surgery.w: Likitan tiyata yana cire ciwon dajin kuma, inda ake buƙata, mahaifa, mahaifar ƙwai da ƙwayoyin lymph na kusa. Don ciwon daji na mahaifar ƙwai da ya yi nisa, tiyata mai faɗi (ultra-radical) tana ƙoƙarin cire dukan cutar da ake gani. A matan matasa masu ciwon daji na farko, tiyatar kiyaye haihuwa na iya kiyaye mahaifa ko mahaifar ƙwai ɗaya. Ana amfani da tiyata ta ƙaramar huda da ta robot inda suka dace.
Mata masu ciwon daji na mahaifar ƙwai (ovary), mahaifa, bakin mahaifa (cervix) ko farji na waje (vulva), da wasu sarcoma na gaɓoɓin mata.
treatments.gynaecologic-cancer-surgery.s: Yawanci kwana 3 zuwa 10 a asibiti. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.gynaecologic-cancer-surgery.r: Yawanci mako 4 zuwa 6. Chemotherapy ko radiotherapy na iya biyo baya.
treatments.gynaecologic-cancer-surgery.f: Shin har yanzu zan iya haihuwa?
Wani lokaci, don ciwon daji na farko a matan matasa. Ku gaya wa likita idan wannan yana da muhimmanci a gare ku, don ya zama ɓangare na shirin tun farko.
Shin ana ba da chemotherapy kafin tiyata?
Don wasu ciwon daji na mahaifar ƙwai da suka yi nisa, i, don rage cutar da farko. Ƙungiyar tana yanke shawara daga hotunan na'urarku.
treatments.bone-cancer-surgery.name: Tiyatar ciwon daji na ƙashi (kiyaye gaɓa)
treatments.bone-cancer-surgery.summary: Tiyata da ke cire ciwacen ƙashi ko na nama mai laushi tare da kiyaye hannu ko ƙafa, maimakon yanke su.
treatments.bone-cancer-surgery.what: Ana cire ciwacen tare da ɗan lafiyayyen nama a gefensa, kuma ana sake gina ƙashin da ya ɓace da abin ƙarfe da ake sakawa a jiki (endoprosthesis), ƙashi daga bankin ƙashi, ko ƙashin mara lafiyar kansa. Yawancin mutane masu ciwon daji na ƙashi a yau suna kiyaye gaɓarsu. Sau da yawa ana ba da chemotherapy kafin da bayan tiyata.
treatments.bone-cancer-surgery.who: Yara da manya masu ciwon daji na ƙashi kamar osteosarcoma da Ewing's sarcoma, sarcoma na nama mai laushi, wasu ciwace-ciwacen ƙashi da ba ciwon daji ba amma masu ƙarfi, da ciwon dajin da ya yaɗu zuwa ƙashi.
treatments.bone-cancer-surgery.stay: Yawanci kwana 5 zuwa 10 a asibiti. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.bone-cancer-surgery.recovery: Yawanci mako 6 zuwa 12, tare da jinyar motsa jiki (physiotherapy) don sake tafiya ko amfani da hannu.
treatments.bone-cancer-surgery.faq.0.ans: A yawancin lokuta, a'a. Kiyaye gaɓa yana yiwuwa ga yawancin ciwace-ciwacen ƙashi. Likitan tiyata zai gaya muku bayan ya duba hotunan na'urarku.
treatments.bone-cancer-surgery.faq.1.que: Har yaushe abin da aka saka yake ɗauka?
treatments.bone-cancer-surgery.faq.1.ans: Da yawa suna ɗaukar shekaru masu yawa. Wasu na iya buƙatar maye gurbinsu daga baya, musamman a yaran da har yanzu suke girma.
treatments.liver-tumour-embolisation.nam: Toshe hanyar jinin ciwacen hanta (TACE da TARE)
treatments.liver-tumour-embolisation.sum: Ta wata ƙaramar huda a maƙwancin cinya ko wuyan hannu, ana jagorantar wani siririn bututu zuwa jijiyar jinin da ke ciyar da ciwacen hanta, sannan a kai chemotherapy (TACE) ko ƙananan ƙwayoyin radioactive (TARE) kai tsaye cikinsa.
treatments.liver-tumour-embolisation.wha: Likitan interventional radiology yana jagorantar siririn bututu ta jijiyar jini zuwa hanta ta amfani da hoton X-ray. A TACE (chemoembolisation), ana kai chemotherapy cikin ciwacen kuma a toshe hanyar jininsa. A TARE (radioembolisation), ana kai ƙananan ƙwayoyi masu ɗauke da haske (radiation) maimakon haka. Babu buɗaɗɗiyar tiyata, ƙaramar huda kawai.
treatments.liver-tumour-embolisation.who: Mutane masu ciwon daji na hanta, ko ciwon dajin da ya yaɗu zuwa hanta, wanda ba za a iya cire shi da tiyata ba, ko a matsayin gada zuwa tiyata ko dashe.
treatments.liver-tumour-embolisation.sta: Yawanci kwana 1 zuwa 2 a asibiti. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.liver-tumour-embolisation.rec: Yawancin mutane suna jin gajiya, tare da ɗan ciwo ko zazzaɓi, na kusan mako ɗaya, sannan su koma rayuwarsu ta yau da kullum.
treatments.liver-tumour-embolisation.faq: Ana yin sa da allurar kashe zafi ta wuri da maganin kwantar da hankali. Ɗan ciwo da zazzaɓi bayan haka abu ne da aka saba kuma ana jinyar su da magunguna.
Shin zan buƙaci fiye da zama ɗaya?
Wani lokaci. Hoton na'ura bayan kusan mako 4 zuwa 6 yana nuna yadda ciwacen ya amsa.
treatments.tumour-ablation.name: Ƙona ciwace (radiofrequency da microwave)
treatments.tumour-ablation.summary: Allura da hoton na'ura ke jagoranta tana lalata ƙaramin ciwace da zafi, ba tare da buɗaɗɗiyar tiyata ba.
treatments.tumour-ablation.what: Ta amfani da ultrasound ko CT, likitan interventional radiology yana saka siririyar allura cikin ciwacen ta fata. Allurar tana zafafa ciwacen da raƙuman rediyo ko microwave har sai ya lalace. Yana ɗaukar kusan awa ɗaya, yana barin ƙaramar huda kawai, kuma ana iya maimaita shi.
treatments.tumour-ablation.who: Mutane masu ƙananan ciwace-ciwace a hanta, ƙoda, huhu ko ƙashi, musamman waɗanda tiyata ba ta dace da su ba.
treatments.tumour-ablation.stay: Yawanci kwana 1 a asibiti. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.tumour-ablation.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum cikin ʼyan kwanaki.
treatments.tumour-ablation.faq.0.questio: Shin yana da kyau kamar tiyata?
treatments.tumour-ablation.faq.0.answer: Ga wasu ƙananan ciwace-ciwace, sakamakon yana kusa da na tiyata. Ƙungiyar likitoci za ta ba ku shawara kan wanda ya dace da ciwon ku.
treatments.tumour-ablation.faq.1.questio: Ta yaya zan san cewa ya yi aiki?
treatments.tumour-ablation.faq.1.answer: Hoton jiki (scan), yawanci bayan kusan wata ɗaya, yana tabbatar da cewa an yi wa dukkan ciwon magani.
treatments.brain-tumour-surgery.name: Tiyatar ciwon ƙwaƙwalwa (craniotomy)
treatments.brain-tumour-surgery.summary: Tiyata wadda likitan fiɗa yake buɗe ƙaramin sashe na ƙoƙon kai domin cire ko rage ciwo (tumour) a cikin ƙwaƙwalwa.
treatments.brain-tumour-surgery.what: Ana ɗaga ƙaramar taga ta ƙoƙon kai, a cire ciwon gwargwadon yadda ba shi da haɗari, sannan a mayar da ƙashin. Na'urar jagora da madubin hangen nesa na tiyata suna jagorantar likitan fiɗa, kuma ana yin wasu tiyatoci yayin da majiyyaci yake a farke domin kare magana da motsi. Ana duba naman da aka cire domin tsara ƙarin magani.
treatments.brain-tumour-surgery.who: Mutanen da ke da ciwon ƙwaƙwalwa, ko na daji ne ko ba na daji ba, kamar glioma, meningioma, ciwon glandar pituitary da ciwace-ciwacen da suka bazu zuwa ƙwaƙwalwa.
treatments.brain-tumour-surgery.stay: Kusan kwanaki 5: 1 a sashen kulawa ta musamman (ICU) da 4 a cikin ɗakin marasa lafiya a Nanavati Max Super Speciality Hospital. Asibitin ku zai tabbatar da shi don yanayin ku.
treatments.brain-tumour-surgery.recovery: Yawanci makonni 4 zuwa 8. Ku shirya zama a Indiya na kusan makonni 2 bayan tiyata.
treatments.brain-tumour-surgery.faq.0.an: Yawanci ƙaramin layi kawai, kuma gashi yana sake fitowa a kan tabon.
treatments.brain-tumour-surgery.faq.1.qu: Zan buƙaci maganin hasken rediyo (radiotherapy) daga baya?
treatments.brain-tumour-surgery.faq.1.an: Ya danganta da irin ciwon. Rahoton naman da aka cire ne yake jagorantar wannan.
treatments.deep-brain-stimulation.name: Motsa zurfin ƙwaƙwalwa da wutar lantarki (DBS)
treatments.deep-brain-stimulation.summar: Ƙaramar na'ura da ake sanyawa ƙarƙashin fata tana aika da saƙonnin wutar lantarki masu sauƙi zuwa wani sashe na ƙwaƙwalwa, ana amfani da ita don wasu cututtukan motsi kamar cutar Parkinson.
treatments.deep-brain-stimulation.what: Ana sanya siraran wayoyi a wani takamaiman wuri a cikin zurfin ƙwaƙwalwa, a haɗa su da ƙaramin batir ƙarƙashin fatar ƙirji, kamar na'urar bugun zuciya (pacemaker). Saƙonnin suna kwantar da kuskuren aikin ƙwaƙwalwa da ke haddasa rawar jiki da taurin jiki. Ana daidaita saitunan a cikin makonni masu zuwa.
treatments.deep-brain-stimulation.who: Mutanen da ke da cutar Parkinson waɗanda magungunansu ba sa sarrafa alamominsu da kyau, da wasu masu rawar jiki (tremor) ko dystonia.
treatments.deep-brain-stimulation.stay: Yawanci kwanaki 3 zuwa 5 a asibiti. Asibitin ku zai tabbatar da shi don yanayin ku.
treatments.deep-brain-stimulation.recove: Yawanci makonni 2 zuwa 4, tare da daidaita saituna a ziyarori kaɗan.
Shin yana warkar da cutar Parkinson?
A'a, amma yana iya rage rawar jiki, taurin jiki da sauye-sauyen tasirin magani sosai, kuma sau da yawa yana sa mutane su sha magani ƙasa da da.
Ana iya canza saitunan bayan na koma gida?
Eh. Ana iya daidaita saitunan a ziyarori na gaba, kuma likitan jijiyoyi a ƙasarku zai iya duba na'urori da yawa.
treatments.spinal-fusion.name: Haɗa ƙasusuwan kashin baya (spinal fusion)
treatments.spinal-fusion.summary: Tiyata da ke haɗa ƙasusuwa biyu ko fiye na kashin baya don su warke su zama ɗaya, domin daidaita wani sashe na baya ko wuya mai ciwo ko mara ƙarfi.
treatments.spinal-fusion.what: Ƙusoshi da sandunan ƙarfe suna riƙe ƙasusuwan a tsaye yayin da ƙarin ƙashi (bone graft) yake taimaka musu su girma tare. Idan ya dace da yanayin, ana yin ta ta hanyar tiyata ƙarama ta ƙananan yanka, da na'urar jagora domin sanya ƙusoshin daidai, wanda yawanci yana nufin ƙarancin ciwo da komawa gida da wuri.
treatments.spinal-fusion.who: Mutanen da kashin bayansu ba shi da ƙarfi ko ya zame (spondylolisthesis), tsananin lalacewar faifan kashin baya (disc), karaya, karkacewa, ko ciwace-ciwacen kashin baya, idan wani magani bai taimaka ba.
treatments.spinal-fusion.stay: Kusan kwanaki 5 har zuwa matakai biyu: 1 a sashen kulawa ta musamman (ICU) da 4 a cikin ɗakin marasa lafiya a Nanavati Max Super Speciality Hospital. Asibitin ku zai tabbatar da shi don yanayin ku.
treatments.spinal-fusion.recovery: Ana fara tafiya washegarin tiyata. Yawancin mutane suna komawa aiki mai sauƙi cikin makonni 4 zuwa 6, kuma ƙasusuwan suna haɗuwa cikin watanni 3 zuwa 6.
treatments.spinal-fusion.faq.0.question: Zan rasa motsi a bayana?
treatments.spinal-fusion.faq.0.answer: Haɗa mataki ɗaya ko biyu ba ya kawo bambanci sosai ga motsin yau da kullum.
treatments.spinal-fusion.faq.1.question: Yaushe zan iya tashi zuwa gida?
treatments.spinal-fusion.faq.1.answer: Yawanci kusan makonni 2 bayan tiyata, bayan an duba raunin.
treatments.acdf.name: Cire faifan wuya ta gaba da haɗa ƙasusuwa (ACDF)
treatments.acdf.summary: Ta ƙaramin yanka a gaban wuya, ana cire faifan (disc) da ya lalace wanda ke danne jijiyoyi ko laka, sannan a haɗa ƙasusuwan da ke gefensa.
treatments.acdf.what: Likitan fiɗa yana kaiwa ga kashin baya ta gaban wuya, ya cire faifan da ya lalace ko ya zame da duk wani tsiron ƙashi da ke danne jijiyoyi, sannan ya sanya ƙaramin abin raba ƙasusuwa domin ƙasusuwan biyu su girma tare.
treatments.acdf.who: Mutanen da ke da ciwon hannu, sanyin jiki ko raunin hannu, ko matsalar daidaito da amfani da hannu, sakamakon faifan wuya da ya zame ko ya lalace.
treatments.acdf.stay: Kusan kwanaki 4: 1 a sashen kulawa ta musamman (ICU) da 3 a cikin ɗakin marasa lafiya a Nanavati Max Super Speciality Hospital. Asibitin ku zai tabbatar da shi don yanayin ku.
treatments.acdf.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna komawa ayyuka masu sauƙi cikin makonni 2 zuwa 4.
treatments.acdf.faq.0.question: Shin maye gurbin faifan ya fi kyau?
treatments.acdf.faq.0.answer: Ga wasu mutane, maye gurbin faifan yana kiyaye motsin wuya maimakon haɗa ƙasusuwa. Likitan fiɗa zai ba ku shawara kan wanda ya dace da ku.
treatments.acdf.faq.1.question: Zan sami wahalar haɗiye abu?
treatments.acdf.faq.1.answer: Ɗan ciwon maƙogwaro ko wahalar haɗiye na ʼyan kwanaki abu ne da aka saba, kuma yawanci yana wucewa da sauri.
treatments.cervical-disc-replacement.sum: Ana maye gurbin faifan wuya da ya lalace ko ya zame da faifan roba (na wucin gadi) wanda ke barin wuya yana motsi.
treatments.cervical-disc-replacement.wha: Ta ƙaramin yanka a gaban wuya, ana cire faifan da ya lalace a sanya faifan roba a wurinsa. Ba kamar haɗa ƙasusuwa ba, gaɓar tana ci gaba da motsi, wanda zai iya kare faifan da ke sama da ƙasa.
treatments.cervical-disc-replacement.who: Matasa da mutane masu ƙwazo da ke da ciwon hannu ko sanyin hannu sakamakon faifan wuya ɗaya ko biyu da suka lalace ko suka zame, ba tare da babbar amosanin gaɓoɓi ba.
treatments.cervical-disc-replacement.sta: Yawanci kwanaki 2 zuwa 3 a asibiti. Asibitin ku zai tabbatar da shi don yanayin ku.
treatments.cervical-disc-replacement.rec: Yawancin mutane suna komawa ayyuka masu sauƙi cikin makonni 2 zuwa 3.
treatments.cervical-disc-replacement.faq: Su waye ba su dace ba?
Mutanen da ke da tsananin amosanin gaɓoɓin wuya, kashin baya mara ƙarfi ko raunanan ƙasusuwa, yawanci haɗa ƙasusuwa ya fi dacewa da su.
Har yaushe faifan roba yake ɗorewa?
An ƙera faifan roba na zamani don su ɗore shekaru masu yawa. Likitan fiɗa zai bayyana irin wanda aka yi amfani da shi.
treatments.microdiscectomy.name: Microdiscectomy da laminectomy
treatments.microdiscectomy.summary: Tiyata ta ƙaramin rami a ƙasan baya da ke cire ɓangaren faifan da ya zame, ko na ƙashi, da ke danne jijiya, domin rage ciwon sciatica da ciwon ƙafa.
treatments.microdiscectomy.what: Ta ƙaramin yanka, da amfani da madubin hangen nesa, likitan fiɗa yana cire ɓangaren faifan da ke danne jijiyar (microdiscectomy) ko ya faɗaɗa hanyar kashin baya da ta takura ta hanyar cire ɗan ƙashi (laminectomy).
treatments.microdiscectomy.who: Mutanen da ke da sciatica ko ciwon ƙafa, sanyin ƙafa ko raunin ƙafa sakamakon faifan da ya zame ko hanyar kashin baya da ta takura, idan magunguna da motsa jiki na likita (physiotherapy) ba su taimaka ba.
treatments.microdiscectomy.stay: Kusan kwanaki 3 a cikin ɗakin marasa lafiya a Nanavati Max Super Speciality Hospital. Asibitin ku zai tabbatar da shi don yanayin ku.
treatments.microdiscectomy.recovery: Ciwon ƙafa yakan sauƙaƙa nan take. Yawancin mutane suna komawa aiki mai sauƙi cikin makonni 2 zuwa 4.
treatments.microdiscectomy.faq.0.answer: Wani lokaci. Physiotherapy da motsa jiki na ƙarfafa tsakiyar jiki suna taimakawa wajen rage yiwuwar hakan.
treatments.microdiscectomy.faq.1.questio: Ana iya yin ta da na'urar endoscope?
treatments.microdiscectomy.faq.1.answer: Sau da yawa, eh. Tiyatar endoscope tana amfani da yanka mafi ƙanƙanta. Likitan fiɗa zai ba ku shawara kan wanda ya dace da faifan ku.
treatments.endoscopic-spine-surgery.summ: Tiyatar kashin baya ta yanka na kusan santimita ɗaya, da amfani da siririyar kyamara, domin ƴantar da jijiyar da aka danne.
treatments.endoscopic-spine-surgery.what: Ana shigar da siririn bututu mai kyamara (endoscope) zuwa kashin baya ta ƙaramin yanka sosai. Likitan fiɗa yana cire faifan da ya zame ko ƙashin da ke danne jijiyar yayin da yake kallo a kan allo. Ana kawar da tsokoki gefe maimakon a yanke su.
treatments.endoscopic-spine-surgery.who: Mutanen da ke da sciatica ko ciwon hannu sakamakon faifan da ya zame, ko hanyar kashin baya da ta takura a mataki ɗaya ko biyu.
treatments.endoscopic-spine-surgery.stay: Sau da yawa a rana ɗaya ko dare 1 a asibiti. Asibitin ku zai tabbatar da shi don yanayin ku.
treatments.endoscopic-spine-surgery.reco: Yawancin mutane suna tafiya cikin ʼyan sa'o'i kuma suna komawa aiki mai sauƙi cikin makonni 1 zuwa 2.
Ana yin ta ne da maganin sa barci gaba ɗaya?
Wani lokaci da maganin kashe jin wuri ɗaya tare da maganin kwantar da hankali, wani lokaci da sa barci gaba ɗaya. Ƙungiyar likitoci za ta yanke shawara tare da ku.
Shin ya dace da kowace matsalar kashin baya?
A'a. Ya dace da jijiyoyin da aka danne a mataki ɗaya ko biyu. Rashin ƙarfin kashin baya ko karkacewa yawanci suna buƙatar ɗaurewa da ƙusoshi.
treatments.scoliosis-surgery.name: Gyaran karkacewar kashin baya (scoliosis)
treatments.scoliosis-surgery.summary: Tiyata da ke miƙe kashin baya mai lanƙwasa ta kuma daidaita shi, ga matasa da manya.
treatments.scoliosis-surgery.what: Ana ɗaure ƙusoshi da sandunan ƙarfe a kashin baya domin miƙe lanƙwasar da riƙe ta yayin da ƙasusuwan suke haɗuwa. Na'urar jagora da sa ido kan jijiyoyi yayin tiyata suna taimakawa wajen kiyaye lafiya.
treatments.scoliosis-surgery.who: Matasa da manya masu lanƙwasar kashin baya (scoliosis ko kyphosis) wadda take da girma, take ƙara muni, ko take haddasa ciwo ko matsalar numfashi.
treatments.scoliosis-surgery.stay: Yawanci kwanaki 5 zuwa 7 a asibiti. Asibitin ku zai tabbatar da shi don yanayin ku.
treatments.scoliosis-surgery.recovery: Ana fara tafiya cikin kwana ɗaya ko biyu. Makaranta ko aikin ofis yawanci yana komawa cikin makonni 4 zuwa 6, wasanni kuma cikin watanni 6 zuwa 12.
treatments.scoliosis-surgery.faq.0.quest: Ɗana zai yi girma kamar yadda ya kamata bayan tiyata?
treatments.scoliosis-surgery.faq.0.answe: Yawanci ana yin tiyatar kusa da ƙarshen lokacin girma. Likitan fiɗa zai bayyana mafi dacewar lokaci ga ɗanku.
treatments.scoliosis-surgery.faq.1.answe: Yawancin lanƙwasa suna raguwa sosai, ko da yake ba koyaushe suke miƙewa gaba ɗaya ba. Daidaito da jin daɗi su ne manyan manufofi.
treatments.gastric-sleeve.name: Rage ciki zuwa siririn bututu (gastric sleeve)
treatments.gastric-sleeve.summary: Tiyata ta ƙananan ramuka da ke cire babban ɓangare na ciki (tumbi), ta bar siririn bututu, domin mutum ya ji ƙoshi da wuri.
treatments.gastric-sleeve.what: Ana cire kusan kashi uku cikin huɗu na ciki ta tiyata ta ƙananan ramuka, a bar siririn bututu. Ƙaramin cikin yana ɗaukar abinci kaɗan kuma yana samar da ƙarancin sinadarin (hormone) da ke haddasa yunwa.
treatments.gastric-sleeve.who: Manya masu ma'aunin nauyin jiki (BMI) na kusan 35 ko fiye, ko 30 ko fiye tare da ciwon suga, hawan jini ko matsalar daina numfashi lokacin barci (sleep apnoea), bayan abinci da motsa jiki ba su yi aiki ba. Ma'aunin zai iya zama ƙasa ga mutanen asalin Asiya.
treatments.gastric-sleeve.stay: Yawanci kwanaki 2 zuwa 3 a asibiti. Asibitin ku zai tabbatar da shi don yanayin ku.
treatments.gastric-sleeve.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna komawa aikin ofis cikin makonni 1 zuwa 2, suna sauyawa daga abinci mai ruwa zuwa abinci na yau da kullum cikin kusan makonni 6.
treatments.gastric-sleeve.faq.0.question: Nauyi nawa zan rasa?
treatments.gastric-sleeve.faq.0.answer: Mutane da yawa suna rasa kusan kashi 60 zuwa 70 cikin ɗari na ƙarin nauyinsu cikin shekara ɗaya zuwa biyu, tare da abinci da motsa jiki.
treatments.gastric-sleeve.faq.1.question: Zan buƙaci bitamin daga baya?
treatments.gastric-sleeve.faq.1.answer: Eh, yawanci bitamin a kowace rana da gwajin jini akai-akai.
treatments.gastric-bypass.name: Ketare ciki (Roux-en-Y gastric bypass)
treatments.gastric-bypass.summary: Tiyata da ke yin ƙaramar jakar ciki ta haɗa ta can ƙasa a ƙaramar hanji, domin a ci abinci kaɗan kuma a sha ƙasa.
treatments.gastric-bypass.what: Ta tiyata ta ƙananan ramuka, ana yin ƙaramar jaka a saman ciki a haɗa ta kai tsaye da ƙasan ɓangaren ƙaramar hanji, ana ketare sauran cikin. Abinci kaɗan ne yake shiga, kuma ana shan ƙarancin kalori.
treatments.gastric-bypass.who: Manya masu tsananin ƙiba, musamman masu ciwon suga na nau'i na 2 ko tsananin ƙwannafi (acid reflux), bayan wasu hanyoyi ba su yi aiki ba.
treatments.gastric-bypass.stay: Yawanci kwanaki 2 zuwa 4 a asibiti. Asibitin ku zai tabbatar da shi don yanayin ku.
treatments.gastric-bypass.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna komawa aikin ofis cikin makonni 2, tare da tsarin abinci mataki-mataki cikin kusan makonni 6.
treatments.gastric-bypass.faq.0.question: Zai taimaki ciwon sugana?
treatments.gastric-bypass.faq.0.answer: Sau da yawa, eh. Mutane da yawa suna buƙatar ƙarancin maganin ciwon suga, wasu kuma suna dainawa, bayan ketare ciki.
treatments.gastric-bypass.faq.1.question: Sleeve ko bypass: wanne ya dace da ni?
treatments.gastric-bypass.faq.1.answer: Ya danganta da nauyinku, ƙwannafi, ciwon suga da sauran lafiyarku. Likitan fiɗa zai ba ku shawara bayan an duba ku.
treatments.ivf.name: Haɗa ƙwai da maniyyi a ɗakin gwaje-gwaje (IVF)
treatments.ivf.summary: Ana tattara ƙwai a haɗa su da maniyyi a ɗakin gwaje-gwaje, sannan a sanya ɗan tayi (embryo) a cikin mahaifa.
treatments.ivf.what: Allurar sinadaran hormone suna taimaka wa kwayayen mace (ovaries) su samar da ƙwai da yawa, waɗanda ake tattarawa a cikin gajeren aiki ƙarƙashin maganin kwantar da hankali. Ana haɗa su da maniyyi a ɗakin gwaje-gwaje, bayan ʼyan kwanaki kuma ana sanya ɗan tayi ɗaya a cikin mahaifa ta siririn bututu. Ana iya daskarar da ragowar ʼyan tayi.
treatments.ivf.who: Ma'auratan da ba su samu ciki ba bayan ƙoƙari, ciki har da masu toshewar bututun mahaifa, ƙarancin ƙwai, endometriosis, ko rashin haihuwa da ba a san dalilinsa ba.
treatments.ivf.stay: Babu kwanciya a asibiti: tattara ƙwai da sanya ɗan tayi ayyuka ne na rana ɗaya.
treatments.ivf.recovery: Yawancin mata suna komawa harkokinsu washegarin kowane aiki. Zagaye ɗaya yana ɗaukar kusan makonni 3 zuwa 4 a Indiya; ana yin gwajin ciki kusan makonni 2 bayan sanya ɗan tayi.
treatments.ivf.faq.0.question: Har yaushe za mu zauna a Indiya?
treatments.ivf.faq.0.answer: Yawanci kusan makonni 3 zuwa 4 don zagaye ɗaya. Ana iya fara wasu gwaje-gwaje da allurai na farko a gida.
treatments.ivf.faq.1.question: Mene ne yiwuwar nasara?
treatments.ivf.faq.1.answer: Ya fi dogara ne kan shekarun matar da dalilin rashin haihuwa. Likita zai ba ku ƙiyasi bayan gwaje-gwaje.
treatments.icsi.name: Allurar maniyyi cikin ƙwai (ICSI)
treatments.icsi.summary: Wani nau'in IVF ne inda ake allurar maniyyi guda ɗaya kai tsaye cikin kowane ƙwai, ana yawan amfani da shi idan akwai matsala da maniyyi.
treatments.icsi.what: Yana bin matakai iri ɗaya da IVF, amma maimakon haɗa ƙwai da maniyyi, ƙwararren ɗakin gwaje-gwaje (embryologist) yana allurar maniyyi ɗaya cikin kowane ƙwai ƙarƙashin madubin hangen nesa. Ana kuma iya tattara maniyyi kai tsaye daga ƙwalatai idan babu shi a cikin maniyyin da aka fitar.
treatments.icsi.who: Ma'aurata inda namijin yake da ƙarancin maniyyi, maniyyi mara motsi sosai ko babu maniyyi a cikin abin da ya fitar, ko inda IVF bai haifar da haɗuwar ƙwai da maniyyi ba a da.
treatments.icsi.stay: Babu kwanciya a asibiti: duk matakai ayyuka ne na rana ɗaya.
treatments.icsi.recovery: Kamar na IVF: kusan makonni 3 zuwa 4 a Indiya don zagaye ɗaya.
treatments.icsi.faq.0.question: Idan babu maniyyi a cikin abin da aka fitar fa?
treatments.icsi.faq.0.answer: Sau da yawa ana iya ɗaukar maniyyi daga ƙwalatai a cikin ƙaramin aiki a yi amfani da shi don ICSI.
treatments.icsi.faq.1.question: Shin ICSI ya fi IVF nasara?
treatments.icsi.faq.1.answer: Ba gaba ɗaya ba. Yana taimakawa musamman idan matsalar tana tare da maniyyi.
treatments.knee-replacement.name: Cikakken maye gurbin gwiwa
treatments.knee-replacement.summary: Tiyata da ke maye gurbin saman gaɓar gwiwa da suka lalace da sassan ƙarfe da roba.
treatments.knee-replacement.what: Ana cire saman ƙashin cinya da na ƙauri da suka lalace a rufe su da sassan ƙarfe, tare da roba a tsakaninsu domin gaɓar ta yi motsi cikin sauƙi. Ana iya amfani da na'urar kwamfuta ko mutum-mutumi (robot) don sanya sassan daidai.
treatments.knee-replacement.who: Mutanen da ke da tsananin ciwon gwiwa da taurinta sakamakon amosanin gaɓoɓi wanda ke hana tafiya da barci, idan magunguna, allurai da physiotherapy ba su taimakawa kuma.
treatments.knee-replacement.stay: Kusan kwanaki 6 don gwiwa ɗaya (1 a ICU, 5 a cikin ɗakin marasa lafiya), ko kwanaki 8 don duka biyu (2 da 6) a Nanavati Max Super Speciality Hospital. Asibitin ku zai tabbatar da shi don yanayin ku.
treatments.knee-replacement.recovery: Ana fara tafiya da taimako washegarin tiyata. Yawancin mutane suna tafiya da kansu cikin makonni 4 zuwa 6 kuma suna tashi zuwa gida bayan kusan makonni 2 zuwa 3.
treatments.knee-replacement.faq.0.questi: Ana iya yin gwiwoyi biyu tare?
treatments.knee-replacement.faq.0.answer: Sau da yawa, eh, idan lafiyarku ta yarda. Hakan yana nufin zama ɗaya a asibiti da murmurewa ɗaya.
treatments.knee-replacement.faq.1.questi: Har yaushe maye gurbin gwiwa yake ɗorewa?
treatments.knee-replacement.faq.1.answer: Yawancinsu suna ɗorewa shekaru 15 zuwa 20 ko fiye.
treatments.hip-replacement.name: Cikakken maye gurbin kwatangwalo
treatments.hip-replacement.summary: Tiyata da ke maye gurbin gaɓar kwatangwalo da ta lalace da ƙwallo da kwano na roba (na wucin gadi).
treatments.hip-replacement.what: Ana maye gurbin ƙwallon da ya lalace a saman ƙashin cinya da kwanon da ke ƙashin ƙugu da sassan wucin gadi da aka yi da ƙarfe, yumɓu (ceramic) ko roba.
treatments.hip-replacement.who: Mutanen da ke da tsananin ciwon kwatangwalo da taurinsa sakamakon amosanin gaɓoɓi, karayar kwatangwalo, ko rashin isar jini zuwa ƙashin kwatangwalo (avascular necrosis).
treatments.hip-replacement.stay: Kusan kwanaki 6 don kwatangwalo ɗaya (1 a ICU, 5 a cikin ɗakin marasa lafiya), ko kwanaki 8 don duka biyu (2 da 6) a Nanavati Max Super Speciality Hospital. Asibitin ku zai tabbatar da shi don yanayin ku.
