treatments.burn-reconstruction.who: Mutane masu sabbin ƙuna, ko tsofaffin tabon ƙuna da suka matse, suke ciwo ko suke hana motsi.
treatments.burn-reconstruction.stay: Daga rana ɗaya zuwa makonni da yawa, ya danganta da ƙunar. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.burn-reconstruction.recovery: Kulawar tabo da jinya suna ci gaba na watanni.
treatments.facial-palsy-reconstruction.s: Tiyata don dawo da motsi da daidaito ga fuskar da ta raunana saboda lalacewar jijiya.
treatments.facial-palsy-reconstruction.w: Matsar da jijiyoyi, matsar da tsokoki ta ƙaramar tiyatar jijiyoyi (microsurgery) da slings na tsaye suna taimakawa wajen dawo da murmushi, rufe ido da daidaitacciyar fuska.
Mutane masu shanyewar fuska saboda Bell's palsy da bai warke ba, tiyata, rauni ko tun haihuwa.
treatments.facial-palsy-reconstruction.s: Yawanci kwana 2 zuwa 5. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.facial-palsy-reconstruction.r: Motsi yana inganta a hankali cikin wata 6 zuwa 12, tare da jinyar fuska.
treatments.skin-laser-treatments.name: Jinyar fata, tabo da laser (dermatology)
treatments.skin-laser-treatments.summary: Laser da ƙananan ayyuka don tabon kuraje, tawadar Allah (moles), kyasuwa (warts), ƙananan tsiron fata, fararen tabo a fata (vitiligo) da zubar gashi a wurare-wurare.
treatments.skin-laser-treatments.what: Jinyar sun haɗa da laser na CO2 da dermabrasion don tabon kuraje, radiocautery don cire tsiro, tiyatar ƙusa, da jinya don vitiligo da alopecia areata.
treatments.skin-laser-treatments.who: Mutane masu tabon kuraje, tsiron da ba a so, vitiligo, zubar gashi a wurare-wurare ko wasu damuwar fata.
treatments.skin-laser-treatments.stay: Babu kwanciya a asibiti: zama a asibiti. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.skin-laser-treatments.recover: Ja yawanci yana lafawa cikin 'yan kwanaki zuwa mako 2.
hospitals.kenia-dental.picture.alt: Ɗakin jinya da kujerar haƙori da shiryayyen nuni mai siffar haƙori
bodyAreas.brain.hint: Ciwace a ƙwaƙwalwa, farfaɗiya, shanyewar ɓarin jiki ko kumburin jijiyar jini, rawar jiki ko sandarewa saboda Parkinson, da sauran matsalolin jijiyoyi.
bodyAreas.face.hint: Gani mai dishi, gilashin da kuke son rabuwa da shi, glaucoma ko matsalar retina, ido mai karkacewa ko fatar ido da ta sauka, haƙoran da suka ɓace ko suka lalace, matsalolin muƙamuƙi, sinus da suka toshe, ciwon daji na baki, harshe ko fata, ko canza kamannin fuska ko hanci.
bodyAreas.neck.hint: Ciwon wuya ko mutuwar hannu saboda faifan ƙashin baya da ya lalace, ƙulli a thyroid, ko ciwon daji a maƙogwaro, akwatin murya ko wuya.
bodyAreas.chest.hint: Ciwon ƙirji, jijiyoyin zuciya da suka toshe, bawul mara kyau, bugun zuciya mara daidai, gazawar zuciya, matsalar zuciyar yaro, ciwace a huhu ko ƙulli a nono.
bodyAreas.belly.hint: Tsakuwar jakar bile, hernia, ciwon appendix, kitse a hanta ko cirrhosis, matsalolin ciki ko hanji, ciwon daji na hanta, saifa (pancreas), ciki ko hanji, ko ƙibar da ke barazana ga lafiya.
bodyAreas.kidneys.hint: Tsakuwar ƙoda, ƙodojin da suka daina aiki, wankin ƙoda (dialysis), ƙodar da ta toshe, ko tsiro a ƙoda.
bodyAreas.spine.name: Ƙashin baya
bodyAreas.spine.hint: Faifan ƙashin baya da ya zame ko ya lalace, ƙashin baya mai karkacewa (scoliosis), ciwace ko rauni a ƙashin baya, ko ciwon baya na dogon lokaci.
bodyAreas.upper-back.name: Saman baya
bodyAreas.upper-back.hint: Ciwo tsakanin ƙasusuwan kafaɗa, ƙashin baya mai karkacewa ko mai lanƙwasa, ko matsala a saman ƙashin baya.
bodyAreas.middle-back.name: Tsakiyar baya
bodyAreas.middle-back.hint: Ciwo a tsakiyar baya, karayar ƙashin baya, ko ciwo daga ƙoda a gefuna.
bodyAreas.lower-back.name: Ƙasan baya
bodyAreas.lower-back.hint: Ciwon ƙasan baya, ciwon jijiyar ƙafa (sciatica) ko ciwon ƙafa saboda faifan da ya zame, ko ƙashin baya da ya lalace ko ke zamewa.
bodyAreas.pelvis.name: Mahaifa, mafitsara, prostate da haihuwa
bodyAreas.pelvis.hint: Wahalar ɗaukar ciki, ƙarin mahaifa (fibroids), ƙuraje masu ruwa ko zubar jini mai yawa, matsalolin prostate ko mafitsara, ko ciwon daji na mahaifa, mahaifar ƙwai, bakin mahaifa, mafitsara, prostate ko ƙwalatai.
bodyAreas.hips.hint: Ciwon kwatangwalo, sandarewa, yagewar guringuntsin kwatangwalo ko gaɓar kwatangwalo da ta lalace.
bodyAreas.knees.hint: Ciwon gwiwa saboda ciwon gaɓoɓi (arthritis), yagewar jijiyar haɗa ƙashi (ligament) ko meniscus, ko guringuntsin da ya lalace bayan raunin wasanni.
bodyAreas.legs.hint: Varicose veins, ciwon ƙafa yayin tafiya, raunin idon sawu, ciwace a ƙashi, ƙafar da ta ji mummunan rauni, ko ƙafa mai kumburi.
bodyAreas.feet.name: Idon sawu da ƙafafu
bodyAreas.feet.hint: Ciwon idon sawu ko ƙafa, targaɗen da bai lafa ba, bunion ko yatsun ƙafa masu lanƙwasa, ƙafa mara lanƙwasa (flat feet), faɗuwar ƙafa (foot drop), ko gyambon ƙafar masu ciwon suga.
bodyAreas.hands.hint: Ciwo ko sandarewar kafaɗa, gwiwar hannu ko wuyan hannu, yagewar jijiyar tsokar kafaɗa, hannayen da suka ji rauni ko suka sandare, raunin hannu bayan raunin jijiya, ko hannu mai kumburi.
wholeBody.skin.name: Fata, tabo da ƙuna
